indicators.name: Hull Butterfly Oscillator
indicators.description: An oscillator built from the difference between a Hull Moving Average and a mirrored-coefficient version of itself: the butterfly-shaped weighting the name comes from. Adaptive levels derived from the oscillator's own magnitude print reversal dots at stretched readings, giving trend direction, exhaustion, and divergence reads in one pane.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: %B
indicators.description: %B distills Bollinger Band position into a single oscillator reading: 1 at the upper band, 0 at the lower, 0.5 at the basis, computed from a 20-bar average with a 2x standard deviation offset. Dashed overbought (1) and oversold (0) levels, a midline, and a gradient fill make band position readable at a glance, with alerts on every threshold and midline cross.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: 1-2-3 Reversal
indicators.description: Detects the three-point trend-change setup on any chart: numbered pivot labels, a dashed trigger level at point 2 and a dotted invalidation level at point 1, built from a 5-bar swing rule with a close-based break by default. Six alerts cover formation, trigger and invalidation on both sides, for traders who want structural reversals called objectively.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: 3-Step Institutional Trap
indicators.description: The 3-Step Institutional Trap flags potential reversals through a three-phase sequence: a sweep of a recent high or low, a close back inside the level, and a break of the trap bar's trigger price. Numbered labels confirm each phase before the buy or sell signal prints, giving traders a structured way to fade stop hunts on any timeframe.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: 3D Opportunity Cone
indicators.description: The 3D Opportunity Cone projects a three-dimensional cone beside price and plots the market inside it along three axes: Stochastic-based value, ATR-based risk, and volume-based conviction. A fading trail shows how conditions traveled through the space, from the Buy Zone at the apex to the Risk Zone at the base, so traders can grade setup quality before entry.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.description: Detects bullish and bearish 5-0 harmonic patterns from confirmed swings, validating the 1.13-1.618 AB/XA and 1.618-2.24 BC/AB extensions and projecting the D zone from BC's defining 0.50 retracement. A reciprocal AB=CD cross-check, a 0.618 invalidation retracement, point and ratio labels and a target line at C complete the build, with ten alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: 5/35 Oscillator
indicators.description: Plots the spread of a 5-period over a 35-period simple moving average of the close as a four-color histogram around zero, and tags confirmed extremes with the traditional 3 and 5 wave-context reads, including the fifth-wave divergence line. Six alerts cover zero crosses and both reads. A momentum histogram purpose-built for wave counters.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: 52 Week High/Low
indicators.description: Plots horizontal lines at the highest high and lowest low reached over the trailing 52 weeks, updating as new data extends or resets those extremes. A toggle additionally displays the all-time high and low of the available price history. This is a straightforward, standard implementation of 52-week extreme levels.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: 80% Rule
indicators.description: An intraday Market Profile tool that builds the prior session's value area and runs the classic 80% rule setup: an open outside value, a re-entry, and 60 minutes of acceptance inside. It marks each identification step, fires the rotation signal toward the opposite value area boundary, and tracks the setup's live state and outcome in a status table.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: 8AM 1H Range & Breaks
indicators.description: 8AM 1H Range & Breaks boxes a defined opening hour, then waits for a close beyond either boundary. After the break it maps order blocks and inversion fair value gaps aligned with the new direction, with mitigation logic that clears tested zones automatically. Built for intraday traders who anchor their bias to the first hour of the day.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: 8am Road Map Zone
indicators.description: The 8am Road Map Zone captures the 8:00-8:15 pre-market range and grades the session against it from the 9:30 open: green above the range high, red below the low, blue while price holds inside. High, low, and midpoint lines extend through the day, giving open-focused traders an instant bias read and levels to trade against.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: 9:30 AM 15m Fib Breakout
indicators.description: The 9:30 AM 15m Fib Breakout measures the first fifteen minutes of the New York session against a 15-minute ATR and, when the opening candle clears the multiplier, projects Fibonacci levels in the direction of its close until midday. Morning traders get volatility-filtered support and resistance for continuation or fade plays.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: ABCD
indicators.description: Detects bullish and bearish AB=CD patterns from alternating confirmed swings, draws the legs, and projects the D completion at the classic 1.000 ratio with optional 1.272 and 1.618 extended variants plus a shaded BC extension zone. C must hold inside a 0.618-0.786 retracement of AB by default, and alerts fire when a pattern forms, when price reaches D, and on confirmed completion.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Absorption
indicators.description: Watches confirmed swing highs and lows for absorption: levels that repeatedly reject heavy volume without breaking. A zone qualifies after 3 tests whose heaviest bar reaches 1.5x average volume with a stalled-result signature, then resolves as held or broken using ATR-scaled margins, with test markers, live statistics and eight alerts along the way.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Acceleration Bands
indicators.description: Plots Price Headley's acceleration bands in their published form: 20-period averages of range-adjusted highs and lows around a simple midline, scaled by a band factor of 4. Optional markers show the classic entry after two consecutive closes beyond a band and the exit on the close back inside, with a gradient fill that intensifies during the acceleration phase.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Accelerator Oscillator
indicators.description: The Accelerator Oscillator measures the change in momentum by subtracting a 5-period simple moving average of the Awesome Oscillator from the Awesome Oscillator itself. It plots the result as a zero-centered histogram, conventionally colored by whether each bar rises or falls from the previous one. This is the standard raw form of Bill Williams' indicator with its classic fixed parameters.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Accumulation vs Distribution Ranges
indicators.description: Detects consolidation ranges (a 20-bar window compressed within 2 ATRs by default), then scores five pieces of evidence (prior trend, rally vs decline volume, close location, springs vs upthrusts, boundary-test volume) into a live accumulation or distribution lean with a dashboard, probe markers, and alerts for lean flips and breakout resolutions.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Accumulation/Distribution
indicators.description: Accumulation/Distribution maintains a cumulative line built from each bar's close location value, the position of the close within the high-low range, multiplied by volume, so bars closing near their highs add volume-weighted pressure and bars closing near their lows subtract it. The line is cumulative with no length parameter. This is the standard raw implementation of Marc Chaikin's Accumulation/Distribution Line.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Accumulative Swing Index
indicators.description: Wilder's Accumulative Swing Index as a complete analysis pane: the running sum of per-bar Swing Index values with an ATR-based or fixed limit-move divisor. It holds confirmed ASI swing levels for breakout validation, auto-draws trendlines on the ASI's own pivots, and can flag price/ASI divergences: the reads the line was designed for.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Adaptive Bounds RSI
indicators.description: Adaptive Bounds RSI replaces the fixed 70/30 lines with thresholds learned from the data: an online K-Means routine clusters recent RSI values into five regimes and moves the overbought and oversold bounds bar by bar. Markers fire only at statistically stretched readings, re-arm after a midline reset, and ship with regime and bound-cross alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Adaptive Harmonic Forecast
indicators.description: Adaptive Harmonic Forecast decomposes recent price into its dominant cycles, fits sine and cosine waves plus a linear trend by least squares, and extends the composite forward as a color-coded projection. Reversal dots mark forecast peaks and troughs, and a dashboard lists the detected cycle periods driving the model.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Adaptive MACD
indicators.description: Adaptive MACD reshapes the classic momentum gauge by market regime: a rolling R-squared reading blends the filter toward trend preservation when price trends and toward cycle detection when it ranges. The MACD line, signal line, and histogram read exactly as traders expect, designed to sit quiet through chop while keeping full divergence duty.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Adaptive Momentum Oscillator
indicators.description: The Adaptive Momentum Oscillator measures momentum from the maximum price delta over a chosen period and renders it as a gradient-colored histogram around zero, smoothed by an adaptive moving average for minimal lag. A signal line times acceleration and zero crosses, and an optional divergence detector flags potential reversals at tunable sensitivity.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Adjustable MA & Alternating Extremities
indicators.description: Adjustable MA & Alternating Extremities plots a moving average whose lag and overshoot are shaped directly through a parametric sine-based kernel, ringed by alternating upper and lower extremities that flag potential reversal points. The average can render as smoothed candles instead of a line, serving crossover builders and range traders alike.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: AI Channels (Clustering)
indicators.description: AI Channels runs rolling K-means clustering over recent prices and draws its channel from the centroids of the lowest, average, and highest clusters. Breaks beyond the extremities signal trend direction, dispersion areas around the extremities gauge how likely a push through is, and the whole structure can display as a trailing stop.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: AI SuperTrend Clustering Oscillator
indicators.description: The AI SuperTrend Clustering Oscillator sweeps a whole range of SuperTrend factors, measures each variant's distance from price, and clusters the results into three lines: most bullish, most bearish, and consensus. Consensus above zero reads as uptrend, and disagreement between the outputs can give early warning of reversals and retracements.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: All Time High (ATH) Levels
indicators.description: Plots a user-defined number of historical all-time highs as horizontal levels, filtered by how long each record stood and how far apart the levels sit. Every level is classified as support or resistance with a strength percentage, giving traders who anchor entries and exits to long-memory reference prices a ranked map of the levels that matter.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Alternative Bar Types
indicators.description: Rebuilds the chart as activity-driven synthetic candles: tick, volume, dollar value, range or delta bars that print when a set amount of activity accumulates rather than on the clock. Defaults to volume bars with an automatic threshold of 10x average activity over 500 chart bars, plus a dashed live forming bar and a dashboard for sizing the threshold.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: AMD FVG Trade Setup
indicators.description: Detects the full accumulation-manipulation-distribution cycle and confirms it with a fair value gap before signaling. Each phase is boxed on the chart, displacement is validated against an ATR threshold, and a projected risk/reward zone frames the resulting long or short setup. Session filters keep the logic focused on the hours you actually trade.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: AMD POC Trade Setup
indicators.description: This indicator identifies the Accumulation, Manipulation, and Distribution market structure. It detects a consolidation range, builds a volume profile to find the Point of Control, and tracks price sweeps beyond range extremes. A trade signal is triggered when price breaks the POC with momentum. The indicator plots entry levels, stops, and take profit targets based on the identified range and manipulation pivot, assisting traders in capturing potential market reversals.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Anchored Clusters Volume Profile
indicators.description: Applies K-Means clustering to a user-anchored time range and draws an independent volume profile for each detected price regime. Every cluster carries its own point of control, color coding, and total-volume label, separating value areas that a single aggregated histogram blends together. Built for traders dissecting a specific swing, event, or range.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Anchored Monte Carlo Shuffled Projection
indicators.description: Projects future price paths by shuffling the bar-to-bar changes recorded since a chart anchor you place, running up to 1,000 randomized simulations forward from the current close. An average line and standard-deviation values frame the projected range, giving traders a volatility-realistic map of where price could travel next.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Anchored Powered KAMA
indicators.description: An anchored take on Kaufman's Adaptive Moving Average that restarts each hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly period, with a power exponent that flattens the average harder in sideways markets. Standard-deviation bands built from the KAMA itself flag period extremes, serving range traders and trend-pullback traders alike.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Anchored VWAP
indicators.description: Plots the volume-weighted average price accumulated from a user-selected anchor time rather than an automatic session reset, so the line reflects the average traded price since that specific bar. Inputs are the anchor time and an optional set of bands around the VWAP. This is a plain, standard implementation of anchored VWAP.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Andrews' Pitchfork
indicators.description: Draws a complete Andrews' Pitchfork (median line, tines, optional warning lines and fill) either automatically from the three most recent confirmed swing pivots or manually from three timestamps. Standard, Schiff and Modified Schiff variants are built in, with alerts for median touches, tine tests and closes breaking outside the fork.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Anti-patterns
indicators.description: Scans swing structure for the five reciprocal-ratio harmonics (anti-Gartley, anti-Bat, anti-Butterfly, anti-Crab and anti-Cypher) using a 10-bar swing length and a 5% ratio tolerance. Completed structures are drawn with XABCD point labels, measured ratios and a completion zone box, and a BC projection cross-check filters implausible completions.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Arbitrage Detector
indicators.description: Monitors one asset across up to 19 crypto exchanges and 13 forex brokers, exposing live price and volume spreads in a sortable on-chart dashboard. A percentile-graded histogram flags unusual spread activity against its own history, helping spread watchers and arbitrage-minded traders spot inefficiencies before they close.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Arbitrage Matrix
indicators.description: Compares price and volume for one asset across every enabled crypto exchange and forex broker in a row-by-column matrix. Each cell quantifies the discrepancy between two venues over your lookback, with gradient coloring that makes the largest mispricings jump out. A marketplace-wide arbitrage scan condensed into a single dashboard.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: ArcTan Oscillator
indicators.description: An oscillator that squashes its output through an arctangent sigmoid, emphasizing trend direction by sign while compressing noise toward the rails. An adjustable pre-gain controls how hard the squeeze is, and a correlation-driven gradient turns red when a reversal may be forming. A clean trend and divergence read for oscillator traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Aroon
indicators.description: Aroon measures how many bars have elapsed since the highest high and lowest low within a lookback window, expressing each as a percentage of the window. It plots the Aroon Up and Aroon Down lines on a 0 to 100 scale with the classic default length of 14. This build is a plain, unmodified implementation of the original indicator.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Ascending Base
indicators.description: Detects the O'Neil-style ascending base mechanically: three pullbacks of 10-20% with rising highs and lows over 40-85 bars, formed above a 50-period trend average. It outlines the structure with per-pullback depths, prints the buy level at the third-pullback high, demands 1.4x average volume on the breakout, and tracks a 7% stop after confirmation.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Asia Sweep Reversals
indicators.description: The Asia Session Range indicator helps traders identify liquidity zones established during the Asian trading session. It highlights session highs and lows and tracks breakouts or sweeps of these levels. It also integrates internal market structure analysis, identifying Break of Structure and Change of Character events. Traders use these signals to find high probability trade setups, complete with automated take profit and stop loss risk boxes based on structural triggers.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Asset-class Seasonality
indicators.description: Applies driver-based seasonal templates by asset class: equity flow windows, grain, natural gas and gasoline supply-demand seasons, yen fiscal-year and month-end FX flows, or a custom window. Each window is shaded on the chart and scored in a dashboard with completed occurrences, mean return, hit rate and a stability split between sample halves.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Astro Cycles
indicators.description: Marks every new and full moon at its exact astronomical time, tags eclipse-window events, projects upcoming lunar dates past the last bar, and shades the new-moon and full-moon halves of each lunation. A dashboard shows the current phase, the next dates, and a descriptive split of the chart's bar returns by lunar half: context, never a signal.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: ATH/ATL Tracker
indicators.description: Charts the price change between each new all-time high or low and the previous record across an instrument's full history, as a histogram with per-record tooltips showing price and date. A dashboard averages how long records take to form and how far they stretch, giving traders a sentiment read on record-setting behavior.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: ATR Exceedance Probability Model
indicators.description: A statistical volatility model that counts breaches of ATR-based thresholds and Z-scores their frequency against a long-term baseline. It classifies Quiet, Normal, and High Vol regimes on the chart and reports continuation odds such as Serial Break Probability. For traders who want volatility expansion measured rather than eyeballed.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: ATR Expansion/contraction
indicators.description: Plots the fast ATR as a signed percentage above or below a slow volatility baseline (a 5-period against a 20-period ATR by default), so expansion and contraction regimes read as swings around zero. Diamonds flag single bars whose true range reaches 2x prevailing ATR, and a dashboard adds state duration, the bar's TR/ATR multiple and an ATR percentile.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: ATR-based Stop Distance
indicators.description: Plots long and short stop levels a configurable ATR multiple away from each bar's close or from a fixed entry price (2x a 14-period Wilder ATR by default) with gradient fills showing the room each stop grants and a dashboard translating the distance into price units, percent and ticks. Alerts fire when price trades to either level.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Auction Failure
indicators.description: Tracks directional probes beyond up to eight auction references (prior session extremes, initial balance, rolling range and prior value area edges) and resolves each one: acceptance after six held closes, or a confirmed failure split into rejection and abandonment by the volume traded beyond the level, with rotation targets projected.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Auto Trend Drawing
indicators.description: Draws the trend the way a trader would sketch it: ATR-normalized price is simplified with the Ramer-Douglas-Peucker algorithm and the surviving pivots are joined by a smooth Catmull-Rom spline. The result is a flowing, hand-drawn-style curve of market structure. A repainting, retrospective tool for bias and structure analysis.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Autocorrelation
indicators.description: Plots the rolling autocorrelation of returns, squared or absolute returns, or detrended price at a chosen lag (lag 1 over a 200-observation window by default) with 2/sqrt(n) significance bands, a 20-lag ACF or PACF correlogram beside the last bar, and a regime dashboard. Alerts flag shifts into momentum, mean-reversion or back-to-noise conditions.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Average Daily Range
indicators.description: The Average Daily Range indicator calculates the historical mean range of daily price movements to project expected price boundaries for the current session. Traders use this tool to identify potential support and resistance levels, define profit targets, or gauge the relative strength of the current day's price action. By comparing the live daily range against the calculated average, users can assess whether volatility is expanding or contracting relative to historical norms.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Average Directional Index
indicators.description: The Average Directional Index system plots three lines: +DI and -DI, which measure upward and downward directional movement from smoothed comparisons of consecutive highs and lows, and the ADX line, which smooths the difference between them to gauge trend strength regardless of direction. Defaults follow Wilder's original settings of DI length 14 and ADX smoothing 14. This build is the unmodified standard calculation.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Average True Range
indicators.description: Average True Range computes the true range of each bar, which is the largest of the high-low range and the gaps from the prior close, then smooths it over 14 periods and plots the result as a volatility line. A smoothing selector offers Wilder's RMA (the classic default) alongside SMA, EMA, and WMA. This build is the standard unaltered ATR calculation.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Awesome Oscillator
indicators.description: The Awesome Oscillator computes the difference between a 5-period and a 34-period simple moving average of the bar midpoint (hl2), plotted as a histogram around a zero line to show shifts in market momentum. Defaults are the classic 5/34 lengths on hl2. This is the standard raw implementation of Bill Williams' oscillator.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Bagging
indicators.description: A working bootstrap-aggregating ensemble on the chart: 50 k-NN base models, each trained on its own resample of a 100-bar window of three standardized features, combined by averaging or majority vote. It plots the bagged prediction against an unbagged reference line, bands member dispersion, and reports out-of-bag error in a dashboard.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Balance of Power
indicators.description: Balance of Power divides the close-minus-open distance by the high-minus-low range of each bar, measuring which side controlled the bar on a scale from -1 to 1. It plots the raw per-bar value by default, with an optional smoothing input to average the series over a chosen length. The build is the standard form of the indicator with nothing added.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Balance vs Imbalance
indicators.description: Balance vs Imbalance classifies the auction regime bar by bar: each session builds a value-area profile, overlapping value areas read as balance while migrating value reads as imbalance, and an acceptance test with optional volume confirmation grades every break of the balance area. Failed probes print as look-above-and-fail and look-below-and-fail markers.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Balanced Price Range
indicators.description: Balanced Price Range finds opposing fair value gaps printed within a pairing window and draws only their overlap as a bullish or bearish zone with a midline, extending it until price violates the far side. Violation can require a close or any wick, and violated zones stay on the chart frozen and recolored. Built for traders staging entries on the first retest.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: BAMM
indicators.description: Automates the Bat Action Magnet Move: it finds a valid Bat front half with B between 0.382 and 0.50 of XA, arms the B level as a trigger line, and on a decisive break projects the magnet leg toward the 0.886 completion. A dashboard tracks state, trigger and target prices, leg progress, and the outcome: target reached, overrun or B reclaimed.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Band Walk
indicators.description: Band Walk confirms when price closes at or beyond one outer band of a Bollinger Bands or Keltner Channel envelope three times within a five-bar window, then tracks the ride until closes stop reaching the band or cross the midline. Labels mark walk start and end, a dashboard counts bars ridden and midline holds, and pullback alerts flag continuation spots for trend traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: BandWidth
indicators.description: BandWidth plots Bollinger Band width normalized by the middle band, with reference lines marking the lowest (Squeeze) and highest (Bulge) readings of a 125-bar lookback and alerts when width enters either extreme or turns up off its low. A volatility-cycle gauge for traders timing compressions before directional moves and stretched width near trend endings.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Bart Pattern
indicators.description: Detects regular and inverted Bart patterns (flat ranges bookended by abrupt vertical moves) using median-filtered edge detection. Settings control edge sensitivity, range flatness, and display mode, including a meme-free simple view. A retrospective study tool for traders examining how these volatile formations tend to resolve.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Belt Hold
indicators.description: Belt Hold scans for bullish and bearish belt hold candles: a long real body opening at, or essentially at, its session extreme against a 14-bar trend and closing at least halfway into the prior candle's range. Each pattern is labeled, its opening extreme extends forward as a dashed invalidation level, and optional next-bar confirmation tightens the signal.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Bessel Filter
indicators.description: Bessel Filter smooths price with a delay-normalized two- or four-pole Bessel low-pass whose near-constant group delay shifts the whole waveform sideways without distorting its shape. Defaults to a 20-bar cutoff with slope-based coloring, offers an optional 10-bar fast line for crossovers, and a dashboard states the filter's nominal delay in bars.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Better Volume Classifications
indicators.description: Better Volume Classifications paints each volume column by benchmarking raw volume, volume times range, and volume divided by range against rolling 20-bar extremes: climax up, climax down, churn, climax churn, or low volume, with a shorter 10-bar window grading weak prints and a dashboard legend tracking when each label last fired.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Bid/ask Imbalance
indicators.description: Bid/ask Imbalance rebuilds every chart bar as an intrabar footprint, classifies volume with the tick rule, and flags levels where one side outweighs the diagonal opposite by a 3:1 ratio with a minimum-volume filter. Stacks of 3+ same-side levels are drawn as bands and tracked through retest and break. For order-flow traders working inside the bar.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Bill Williams Market Facilitation Index
indicators.description: Bill Williams Market Facilitation Index plots range per unit of volume, high minus low divided by volume, as columns colored by the four classic states (green, fade, fake, and squat) read from the joint direction of the index and volume. A dashboard legend tracks the current state and its streak, with alerts on every state change and on green or fade streaks.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Birdies
indicators.description: Birdies derives curved support and resistance from a circle fitted between the latest swing high and low, projecting bird-shaped patterns whose wings act as breakout triggers. Swing validation filters and an ATR buffer keep the signals clean, making it a genuinely different take on levels for breakout and pullback traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Bitcoin Expectile Model
indicators.description: The Bitcoin Expectile Model fits seven expectile log-log regressions across Bitcoin's entire price history, mapping accumulation and distribution zones and extrapolating them forward. Designed for the all-time index on 3-day or weekly log charts, it gives long-horizon investors a statistical frame for tops, bottoms, and forward price paths.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Bitcoin Power Law
indicators.description: The Bitcoin Power Law plots daily Bitcoin closes on double-logarithmic axes and wraps them in a fitted regression channel, following Giovanni Santostasi's power-law theory. Accumulation, fair-value, and overheated zones frame every cycle at a glance, with adjustable multipliers and halving markers for long-horizon Bitcoin analysis.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Bitcoin Power Law Clock
indicators.description: The Bitcoin Power Law Clock spirals Bitcoin's full price history around a 12-hour clock face built on Giovanni Santostasi's power-law model. A hand points at the current cycle position (with 12, 3, 6, and 9 marking tops, consolidations, bottoms, and rallies), giving macro-minded traders a one-glance cycle read.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Bollinger Band Tag Reversion
indicators.description: Bollinger Band Tag Reversion trades outer-band tags back toward the middle band, but only after a confirming close back inside with a range regime filter and a volatility expansion veto passing. Setups, invalidation lines, and resolutions are drawn on the chart, and a dashboard walks the same checks. Defaults: 20/2 bands, 5-bar confirmation, 0.5 ATR stop cushion.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Bollinger Bands
indicators.description: Bollinger Bands plot a 20-period simple moving average with upper and lower bands placed 2 standard deviations of price above and below it, so band width expands and contracts with volatility. Display options include the bands themselves (default), %B, which locates price within the bands, and Bandwidth, which measures their separation. This is the standard implementation using John Bollinger's classic 20/2.0 settings.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Bollinger Bands Breakout Oscillator
indicators.description: The Bollinger Bands Breakout Oscillator measures how decisively price is breaking beyond the Bollinger extremities, plotting opposing bullish and bearish areas whose size scales with breakout strength. Trend traders use the dominant side for direction and the amplitude to judge whether a breakout carries real conviction.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Bollinger Squeeze
indicators.description: Bollinger Squeeze recolors the bands while volatility is compressed under one of three tests (lowest BandWidth of a 125-bar lookback, a BandWidth percentile floor, or both bands inside Keltner Channels), boxes the price range that forms during the squeeze, and marks the release when price closes beyond that range with the bands expanding.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Breakaway Fair Value Gaps
indicators.description: Breakaway Fair Value Gaps flags FVGs that print while price pushes into new range highs or lows: momentum-driven imbalances at the extremes. A statistics dashboard tracks how often, and how fast, such gaps have been mitigated on your chart, arming continuation and mean-reversion traders with actual numbers.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Breaker Blocks with Signals
indicators.description: Breaker Blocks with Signals detects breaker blocks after market structure shifts and fires entry signals when price retests them, framed by premium and discount swing levels for targets and stops. Built-in alerts and strict invalidation rules make it a focused execution tool for breaker-based trading strategies.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Breakout Detector (Previous MTF High Low Levels)
indicators.description: The Breakout Detector monitors previous higher-timeframe highs and lows and signals when price closes through them, projecting take-profit and stop-loss boxes from your chosen win/loss ratio. False-breakout flags, alerts, and a results dashboard make it a self-auditing breakout tool for multi-timeframe traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Breakouts with Tests & Retests
indicators.description: Breakouts with Tests & Retests builds areas of interest from swing points and labels every interaction: solid triangles for tests, color flips on breakouts, hollow triangles for retests. All judged on closes, not wicks. Adjustable area width and swing sensitivity control exactly how many interactions qualify.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Bull/bear Flag
indicators.description: Bull/bear Flag detects textbook flags: an impulse pole at least 3 ATR tall printed with 60% strong closes, a 4-15 bar counter-drift channel fitted by least squares, and a decisive close out in the pole's direction. Poles, channels, measured targets, and breakout, target, and failure markers plot automatically for continuation traders on any timeframe.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Butterworth Filter
indicators.description: Butterworth Filter smooths any source with the recursive two-pole or three-pole Butterworth design at a 20-bar cutoff by default, fed through the published short FIR input average. The line colors by slope, an optional ATR-scaled tolerance band buffers the design's small step overshoot, and alerts cover slope turns and price crosses in both directions.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Buy Sell Calendar
indicators.description: The Buy Sell Calendar grades every day or month as bullish or bearish and lays the verdicts out on an on-chart calendar, scored by your choice of three sentiment methods. Green and red cells plus longer-run bullish percentages expose recurring calendar tendencies at a glance for seasonality-minded traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Buyback Blackout Windows
indicators.description: Buyback Blackout Windows shades the recurring stretches when companies typically pause discretionary share repurchases: from 14 days before each fiscal quarter end until 2 days after results, using a 28-day estimated report lag or your own listed earnings dates. Entry and lift labels, a next-event projection and an in-versus-out return dashboard complete the overlay.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Buyside & Sellside Liquidity
indicators.description: Buyside & Sellside Liquidity marks the levels where stop clusters rest (buyside above recent highs, sellside below recent lows), along with the zones around them and the liquidity voids between. Adjustable detection, display modes, and breach alerts bring ICT-style liquidity mapping to any chart.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Camarilla
indicators.description: Camarilla builds the classic ladder from the prior day, week, or month: rungs H1-H4 and L1-L4 offset from the close by fixed fractions of the range scaled by 1.1, plus H5/L5 extensions. A shaded rotation band between L3 and H3, a day-type panel reading the open, and level-test alerts support both fade and breakout playbooks for intraday traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Candle 2 Closure
indicators.description: Candle 2 Closure detects a four-candle failed-breakout sequence (context, reversal, expansion, continuation) drawn from the TTrades Fractal framework. Equilibrium zones, key levels, reversal filtering, and real-time alerts turn failed range breaks into structured setups across markets and timeframes.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Candle Body Support/Resistance
indicators.description: Support and resistance levels built from high-volatility candle bodies instead of swing points, with every valid test marked by a dot. An ATR-based volatility filter screens for candles with conviction, while Historical and Trailing modes trade off full level memory against a clean, current chart. Made for level-to-level traders who want zones the market actually defended.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Candle Breakout Oscillator
indicators.description: A price-action oscillator that scores how consistently candles close beyond the prior bar's high or low, splitting the market into bullish, bearish, and sideways plots normalized from 0 to 100. Crosses of the 80/20 thresholds flag regime strength, weakness, and chop-to-trend transitions. Suits breakout and momentum traders who want regime context before price confirms it.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Candlestick Channels
indicators.description: A price channel whose extremities converge toward price whenever candlestick patterns print, tightening fastest where formations cluster. A stochastic-based trend read filters which patterns count, and detected formations are highlighted on the chart. For traders who want channel signals and candlestick evidence fused into one adaptive tool.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Candlestick Structure
indicators.description: Detects sixteen classic candlestick formations and filters them against the major trend, with four selectable trend engines and an alignment dashboard scoring each pattern's congruence. Minor-trend candle coloring exposes retracements as they form. Built for pattern traders who only want formations that agree with the larger move.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Cardwell Positive/negative Reversals
indicators.description: Detects Cardwell positive and negative reversals on a 14-period RSI sampled at confirmed 5-bar price swings, with a 200-bar SMA trend filter and a mid-range RSI requirement enabled by default. Confirmed patterns are drawn on the oscillator and the price chart, measured objectives project as dashed target lines, and a dashboard tallies recent patterns into a regime read.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Cause & Effect
indicators.description: Implements Wyckoff's law of cause and effect on a bar chart: trading ranges lasting 20+ bars inside a volatility-capped window are marked as the cause, and each breakout projects an objective zone by scaling the cause's size with the effect-to-cause ratios observed on that chart. Includes pending objectives, an effect path, six alerts, and a campaign dashboard.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: CBC Flip with Targets and Filters
indicators.description: Candle By Candle flip signals confirmed strictly on closes beyond the prior candle's high or low, each plotted with ATR-scaled targets and stops. A session-anchored VWAP filter aligns entries with or against intraday value, while outcome markers and a hit-rate dashboard grade every setup on the chart. A non-repainting framework for systematic price-action traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Center of Gravity
indicators.description: Center of Gravity plots Ehlers's balance-point oscillator: the centroid of a 10-bar window of median price, zero-centered and paired with a one-bar-delayed trigger line. Upward trigger crossings cue cycle troughs and downward crossings cue crests, with a directional gradient fill. A low-lag timing tool for traders working ranging markets.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Central Pivot Range
indicators.description: Central Pivot Range plots the prior period's pivot, top central, and bottom central lines, classifies each new range narrow or wide against a 20-period width history, reports the two-period relationship, and carries untested ranges forward as virgin CPRs. A dashboard sums up width, price location, and virgin count for intraday and swing traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Chaikin Money Flow
indicators.description: Chaikin Money Flow sums close location value multiplied by volume over a lookback window and divides by total volume for the same window, producing an oscillator around zero that reflects whether closes tend to fall in the upper or lower part of each bar's range. The default length is 20 periods. This build follows Marc Chaikin's standard formula directly, with no smoothing or alterations.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Chaikin Oscillator
indicators.description: Chaikin Oscillator plots the difference between a 3-period EMA and a 10-period EMA of the Accumulation/Distribution Line, oscillating around zero to show shifts in the momentum of volume flow. Defaults are the classic 3 and 10 EMA lengths applied to the cumulative A/D line. It is implemented here as the standard raw form of Marc Chaikin's oscillator.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Chaikin Volatility
indicators.description: Chaikin Volatility measures the rate of change of an exponential moving average of the high-low range, plotting a percentage oscillator that rises as the daily trading range expands. Defaults follow the classic settings of a 10-period EMA of the range with a 10-period rate of change. This build is the indicator in its standard raw form as defined by Marc Chaikin.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Chande Forecast Oscillator
indicators.description: Chande Forecast Oscillator plots %F: the percentage gap between the close and the endpoint of a 14-bar least-squares regression fit. Positive readings mean price runs ahead of its fitted trend, negative behind it, with a 3-period signal line for earlier crosses, a zero-anchored gradient, and alerts on both cross types for momentum traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Chande Kroll Stop
indicators.description: Plots trailing stop lines for both directions by taking the extreme price over p bars, offsetting it by x times the ATR, and then smoothing the result with the most protective value over the last q bars. Defaults follow the original parameters of p 10, x 1, and q 9. This is the standard implementation of the Chande Kroll Stop as published.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Chande Momentum Oscillator
indicators.description: The Chande Momentum Oscillator sums gains and losses over a lookback window and expresses their difference as a share of total price movement, yielding an oscillator bounded between +100 and -100. The default length is 9. This is the standard implementation of Chande's momentum oscillator with its usual default.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Chandelier Exit
indicators.description: Plots a trailing stop hung from the highest high (for longs) or lowest low (for shorts) of a lookback window, offset by a multiple of the Average True Range. Defaults are a 22-period ATR with a multiplier of 3, following the classic parameterization. This is the standard raw Chandelier Exit with no added logic.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Chandelier Exit Oscillator
indicators.description: The chandelier stop reworked as an oscillator: price measured against ATR-based trailing stop levels, in raw or normalized 0–100 form, with a timeframe input for multi-timeframe reads. An optional overlay restores the actual stop levels to the chart while trend-colored bars flag direction. For trend riders who want exits they can read at a glance.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Change-Point Detection (CUSUM)
indicators.description: A statistical regime detector that standardizes log-returns and accumulates meaningful deviations CUSUM-style until a threshold confirms a structural shift. Regime lines, pressure bands, and change-point markers show market stability and stress in real time, without repainting. Aimed at systematic traders who want regime turns flagged before lagging averages react.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Channel Continuation
indicators.description: Detects corrective parallel channels inside a clear trend: least-squares parallels fitted through 5-bar pivots with at least two touches per side, a prior impulse of 3+ ATR, and a countertrend slope required by default. Decisive breaks project width and measured-move targets, while countertrend breaks and false breakouts trigger their own warnings.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Chaos Weighted RSI
indicators.description: An RSI whose smoothing adapts to market disorder: a fractal-dimension chaos measure slows the oscillator in erratic tape and speeds it up in clean trends. Classic 70/30 levels, a midline color shift, and pivot-confirmed divergence detection are built in. For momentum traders tired of false RSI extremes showing up in choppy conditions.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Chebyshev Filters
indicators.description: Chebyshev Filters smooths price with a true cascaded-biquad Chebyshev design: Type I for the steepest roll-off with passband ripple, Type II for a flat passband with stopband ripple, at a 20-bar cutoff and order 3 by default. A slope-colored trend line, price-cross markers, and gradient fill serve traders who want engineered smoothing over ad-hoc averages.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Choppiness Index
indicators.description: The Choppiness Index compares the sum of true ranges over a window to the total high-low range of that window, on a log scale normalized to 0 to 100, to quantify whether price is trending or ranging. It plots the index with the classic length of 14 and the conventional 61.8 and 38.2 reference bands. The build is the standard formula as published, without alteration.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Christmas Toolkit
indicators.description: A fully decorated Christmas tree on your chart whose seven ornaments score real conditions (RSI, Stochastic, and EMA position and slope) from very bullish lime to very bearish dark red. The star sums everything into one aggregate sentiment verdict, with fallen stars marking major flips. Festive on the surface, a genuine composite gauge underneath.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Circular Barplot - Oscillators Sentiment
indicators.description: Six normalized oscillators (RSI, Stochastic %K, Linear Correlation, Williams Percent Range, Percent Rank, and Money Flow Index) drawn as concentric circle arcs, where arc length shows how close each sits to its maximum. A central label averages them into one sentiment number and a dashboard lists exact values. A compact sentiment widget for any ticker.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: CISD Projections
indicators.description: Mechanical price targets projected after a confirmed change in state of delivery: the indicator measures the manipulation leg behind the reversal and anchors Fibonacci expansions at 1, 2, 2.5, 4, and 4.5 to it. Range and leg-size filters plus CHoCH invalidation keep only quality setups on the chart. For traders who want objective, repeatable take-profit levels.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Classic Bar Setups
indicators.description: Classic Bar Setups detects Larry Williams' Oops, Joe Ross' gimmee bar, and 80-20 session reversals as complete rules: each label places a working entry stop, draws its protective stop, and cancels on a time-stop. An ADX sideways filter gates gimmee bars, and fills print as triangles. Mechanical bar-pattern trading for session-based markets.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Climactic Action
indicators.description: Climactic Action tags selling and buying climaxes: bars whose volume (2.5x average by default) and range (2x) tower over recent prints while pressing into fresh extremes after an extended move. It then tracks each episode through follow-through confirmation, invalidation, and the lighter-volume secondary test. A Wyckoff-style exhaustion tool.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Clusters Volume Profile
indicators.description: K-Means clustering splits recent history into distinct price regimes and builds an individual volume profile (with its own point of control) for each one. The layout reveals fair-value zones, range versus trend conditions, and where participation truly concentrated. Suited to volume-focused traders who find single time-sliced profiles too blunt an instrument.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Cointegration
indicators.description: Rolling Engle-Granger cointegration testing on the chart: a 252-bar regression of log prices against a comparison symbol yields the hedge ratio, and the residual spread is z-scored and tested for stationarity every bar. Entries fire at z-score crosses of the 2 threshold while the pair tests cointegrated at the 5% level; a dashboard adds half-life and status. For pairs and relative-value traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Commodity Channel Index
indicators.description: The Commodity Channel Index measures how far the typical price deviates from its simple moving average, scaled by mean absolute deviation, producing an unbounded oscillator that commonly ranges around +100 and -100. Defaults are a length of 20 computed on the hlc3 typical price. This is the standard raw implementation of Lambert's CCI.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Compression Into Level
indicators.description: Detects compression into support or resistance: at least three shrinking swings pressing into a level proven by two or more tests, drawn as a tightening wedge with the consumed bases dotted along the approach. A live label grades the squeeze, and resolution prints as a Break through the level or a Reject targeting the compression origin. Built for breakout and reversal traders alike.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Connors RSI
indicators.description: Connors RSI averages three components: a short RSI of price, an RSI of the current up/down streak length, and the percent rank of the one-bar rate of change, producing a fast 0 to 100 oscillator. It uses the classic 3/2/100 defaults, meaning RSI length 3, streak RSI length 2, and a 100-bar percent-rank window. The build is an unmodified implementation of the published formula.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Consecutive Candle Streak Analysis
indicators.description: Counts runs of consecutive higher or lower closes and benchmarks the live streak against every comparable run in the historical lookback. A dashboard reports continuation and reversal probabilities with maximum and average stage moves, and an UNPRECEDENTED alert flags streaks beyond anything on record. Built for swing and position traders on daily and higher timeframes.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Consequent Encroachment
indicators.description: Marks the consequent encroachment of every fair value gap (the 50% line of the imbalance) and optionally the midpoints of prominent candle wicks. Levels are tracked live: solid while respected, dashed once a close trades through, completed on a full fill or wick revisit, with the last 10 of each type kept by default. Eight alerts cover formation, tests, breaches and revisits.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Constance Brown Studies
indicators.description: Constance Brown's RSI studies as published: the Composite Index (9-bar momentum of a 14-period RSI plus a smoothed 3-period RSI) with 13 and 33 period signal averages, the Derivative Oscillator histogram, and the 40-80 bull and 20-60 bear RSI ranges with their exclusive bands shaded. The unbounded Composite prints divergences RSI's scale conceals. For momentum traders who read both lines together.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Continuation
indicators.description: A continuation state machine: it establishes trend from swing structure, boxes each pause, and confirms resumption when price clears the impulse extreme with retracement inside 61.8%, contracting range and thinning volume. Confirmed continuations print an annotated triangle plus a dotted stop level at the pause extreme; deep, stale or structure-breaking pauses invalidate. For trend traders timing the next leg.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Coppock Curve
indicators.description: The Coppock Curve smooths the sum of two rate-of-change readings with a weighted moving average, producing a long-term momentum oscillator around a zero line. Defaults follow the classic formula, a 10-period WMA of the 14-period ROC plus the 11-period ROC. This is the standard implementation of Edwin Coppock's indicator with the original parameters.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Coral Trend
indicators.description: The Coral Trend filter built clean: six cascaded exponential smoothing stages recombined with lag-compensating weights, a 21-period cascade and Constant D at 0.4 by default. The line colors itself by slope (rising or falling is the whole signal) with an optional gradient fill showing price's stretch from the curve, flip markers and four alerts. For trend followers who want one calm line.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Corrective Leg
indicators.description: Classifies completed counter-trend legs as corrective by scoring them against the impulse they retrace: retracement inside 0-100%, speed at most 1x, bar overlap of 50% or more, bodies no larger and travel efficiency under 50%. Confirmed legs are labeled Shallow, Typical or Deep, while a live zone tracks the developing correction with its depth and invalidation level. For structure-first trend traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Correlated Sine Oscillator
indicators.description: A cycle oscillator that detrends price, estimates the dominant cycle's phase, and plots a phase-aligned sine wave normalized between -1 and +1. Zero-line crosses print bullish and bearish triangles while readings near the extremes flag cycle peaks and troughs, giving cycle-focused traders a clean timing read on any market.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Correlation Clusters
indicators.description: A machine learning tool that measures the correlation of up to ten selected tickers against a reference symbol and groups them into clusters with k-means. Instead of scanning a matrix cell by cell, traders see at a glance which assets move together, which move inversely, and which offer genuine diversification.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Correlation Coefficient
indicators.description: Computes the Pearson correlation coefficient between the chart symbol and a second user-selected symbol over a rolling window, plotted as an oscillator between -1 and +1. Defaults are a comparison symbol input and a 20-bar length, with an option to correlate log returns instead of raw prices. This is the standard raw correlation coefficient calculation.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Correlation Trend Indicator
indicators.description: John Ehlers' Correlation Trend Indicator computed as published: the Pearson correlation of the source against an ideal rising line across a 20-bar window, bounded between -1 and +1. Readings beyond the 0.5 threshold mark bullish or bearish trend regimes with an optional background tint, and alerts cover regime starts, the trendless state, and zero crosses.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: CRT Sweep & Setup Highlighter
indicators.description: Projects the previous higher-timeframe range's high and low, flags the moment price sweeps one of those levels, and requires a Fair Value Gap or Market Structure Shift before confirming the setup with projected entry, stop, and target zones. A rules-based workflow for traders who fade liquidity grabs at HTF extremes.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Crypto Liquidation Heatmap
indicators.description: A real-time heatmap that estimates long and short liquidations for the top 29 cryptocurrencies by market cap and ranks them by liquidation value. Color-coded boxes show which side is being forced out, and hovering any asset reveals its price and a full long/short breakdown. A fast read on leverage flushes across the crypto market.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Crypto Wallets Profitability & Performance
indicators.description: Plots the percentage of a cryptocurrency's wallets in profit, at a loss, or breaking even at current prices using IntoTheBlock on-chain data. Smoothed signal lines, an optional Profitability Meter, and performance stats across multiple timeframes turn raw blockchain positioning into a readable sentiment gauge for crypto traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Cubic Bézier Curve Extrapolation
indicators.description: A drawing-style tool that fits a cubic Bézier curve through four user-positioned control points and extrapolates it forward to project the path of price. The curve colors itself by direction and needs almost no configuration: just reposition the points like any drawing object. For traders who want smooth, hand-shaped trend projection.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Currency Strength
indicators.description: Tracks the relative strength of five user-selected currencies by normalizing each one's close-to-open change and summing it across the basket, with readings that reset each period. A configurable strength meter ranks the currencies while an optional scatter plot separates strength from momentum in four color-coded quadrants.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Curve Position
indicators.description: Reads where price sits on its long-run growth curve: a full-history logarithmic regression with deviation bands 2 standard errors wide, position measured 0-100% across the corridor. Below 33.33% is low on the curve and longs have location, above 66.67% shorts do, the middle is equilibrium. A direction gate served with a dashboard showing the fit's point count. Walk-forward, so history does not repaint.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Custom Indices/baskets
indicators.description: Builds a synthetic index from up to ten symbols: rebased prices for buy-and-hold weight drift or compounded returns for a continuously rebalanced basket, weighted equally, manually or by liquidity, with optional currency conversion. A dashboard reports each constituent's weight, level and data status, and the chart symbol can be overlaid rebased the same way. For traders of themes rather than tickers.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Cyber Cycle
indicators.description: The definitive clean build of John Ehlers' Cyber Cycle: a recursive filter (Alpha 0.07) strips trend and noise from the bar midpoint, leaving the mid-frequency cycle beside a one-bar trigger line whose crossings time swing turns. An optional Stochastic Cyber Cycle display rescales readings between -1 and +1 with 0.5 extreme guides. Suited to swing traders working ranging markets.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Cypher
indicators.description: Cypher detects bullish and bearish XABCD Cypher patterns from confirmed swings, validating the B retracement (0.382–0.618 of XA) and C extension (1.272–1.414) before projecting the D completion at the 0.786 retracement of the full XC swing. Completed patterns carry staged CD targets, an X stop line, and fourteen alerts spanning setup to final target.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: D-Shape Breakout Signals
indicators.description: Draws semi-circular arcs between swing points and treats each 'D' as curved support and resistance: one breakout per shape, marked by green, red, or blue dots for upside, downside, and neutral resolutions. A trailing stop-loss line that updates only on confirmed breaks adds built-in risk management for breakout traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Daily Polynomial Regressions
indicators.description: Fits a fresh polynomial regression curve to each trading day's price action inside an expanding session box, colored bullish or bearish by whether the fit ends above or below the day's start. An R-squared label scores how cleanly the session is trending, guiding intraday trend-following and mean-reversion timing.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Damiani Volatmeter
indicators.description: Damiani Volatmeter plots Luis Damiani's trade/no-trade filter: a volatility line from the ratio of 7- and 50-bar ATRs with a lag-suppression term, against a threshold of 1.1 minus the matching standard-deviation ratio. Readings above the threshold allow trend and breakout entries; readings below flag dead conditions. Includes a state dashboard and regime alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Dark Cloud Cover
indicators.description: Detects the dark cloud cover two-candle bearish reversal (a strong bullish candle answered by an open above it and a close deep into its body) with uptrend, new-high, and volume filters grading each print. Dashed trigger and stop levels, hover tooltips, and follow-through alerts turn the pattern into a plannable setup. Defaults use the strict gap open and 50% close depth.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Day Of Week Price Distribution
indicators.description: Builds a box plot of closing prices for each weekday over a configurable window of weeks: median, interquartile range, and hoverable dots carrying price, open-to-close delta, volume, and date. A dashboard totals the extremes, giving traders a statistical answer to whether weekday bias deserves a place in their plan.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Day-type Taxonomy
indicators.description: Day-type Taxonomy classifies every intraday session against the Market Profile day types (normal, normal variation, trend, double-distribution trend, neutral, neutral extreme, and non-trend) from its initial balance and range extensions. It labels the developing type live, stamps the final type at each session close, and tallies type frequencies in a dashboard.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Death Cross
indicators.description: Marks every death cross of a fast and slow moving average (the classic 50/200 SMA pair by default) and grades each event by the slow MA's slope, coloring still-rising crosses as caution and flagging re-crosses within 20 bars as whipsaws. A regime fill, recovery marks, and a context dashboard complete the regime read for position traders and investors.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Decision Trees
indicators.description: Decision Trees grows a CART tree walk-forward on five stationary features (RSI, relative volume, rate of change, Stochastic %K, and ATR %) to predict direction probability, forward return, or forward volatility over a 10-bar horizon. The prediction plots as an oscillator, and a rules table lists every leaf as an auditable if-then rule, marking the live bar's leaf.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Decycler
indicators.description: Decycler plots John Ehlers' simple decycler (price minus its high-pass-filtered cycle content) as a trend-colored baseline directly on the price chart, alongside a decycler oscillator built from 30- and 60-bar cutoffs in its own pane. Zero-line and signal-band crossings act as trend-change triggers, with six alerts covering baseline and oscillator events.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Delta Flow Profile
indicators.description: A dual profile that stacks money flow and volume delta by price level: one histogram shows where trading activity concentrated, the other which side controlled each price. A normalized view benchmarks every row against peak money flow and a Level of Significance line tracks the heaviest zone. Order-flow context for support and resistance.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Delta ZigZag
indicators.description: Delta ZigZag builds swing legs and splits each one into bullish and bearish volume sourced from a lower timeframe or live tick data. Every leg prints its buy percentage where the colors meet, backed by average and normalized delta readouts per line. For traders who want proof that volume supports a swing before trusting the turn.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Demand Index
indicators.description: Demand Index computes James Sibbet's volume-and-price-change composite: normalized volume is split into buying and selling pressure by the size of each volatility-scaled move, and their signed ratio plots around zero with 3-bar EMA smoothing. Dashed levels at +3 and -3 mark extreme spikes, with optional divergence drawing and six alerts covering crosses, extremes, and divergences.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Depth of Market (DOM)
indicators.description: Depth of Market (DOM) rebuilds an order-flow workstation on the chart: a price ladder with bid, sell, buy, and ask volume, a time and sales tape, volume profile, cumulative depth, imbalance highlights, and up to 24 intraday key levels. Data resets daily or by session. Suited to futures and intraday traders who read participation level by level.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Detrended Price Oscillator
indicators.description: The Detrended Price Oscillator subtracts a displaced simple moving average from price, removing the longer trend so shorter cycles stand out around a zero line. It defaults to a length of 21 and includes the conventional centered option, which shifts the plot back to align the oscillator with the price that produced it. The build follows the standard published formula exactly.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Diagonals
indicators.description: Detects five-wave wedges from confirmed swing pivots and classifies each as a leading or ending diagonal, drawing the wave 1-3 and 2-4 boundary lines with wave labels, an invalidation level and an origin target for ending patterns. Confirmed wedges stay monitored for throw-over, the 2-4 line reversal trigger and invalidation, with momentum divergence noted per pattern.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Diamond Top/bottom
indicators.description: Scans alternating swings for expansion into a widest point followed by contraction, verifying touch counts on all four boundary edges before drawing a diamond top or bottom. Completed patterns get a measure-rule target and a breakout-failure watch, an optional sharp-prior-move filter grades the setting, and a dotted preview shows confirmed but unresolved diamonds.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: DiNapoli Levels
indicators.description: Implements DiNapoli's disciplined Fibonacci workflow: stacked F38/F61 retracement sets, one per reaction against a shared focus number, COP/OP/XOP expansion objectives projected from the ABC thrust, and confluence areas where levels from different reactions overlap within an ATR-scaled tolerance. Alerts cover single and double 38.2% penetrations, the 61.8% risk area and each objective.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Directional Matrix
indicators.description: Directional Matrix grids the direction of four moving averages (SMA, TMA, WMA, and linear regression) across a whole range of lengths, coloring each cell bullish or bearish. The top-left cell tallies the bullish share, and a normalized mode grades how strong each change is. A one-glance trend consensus for any chart.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Displaced MA
indicators.description: Plots a moving average slid along the time axis (a 7-period SMA displaced 5 bars forward by default, DiNapoli's 7x5) with slope coloring, price-cross alerts, and the 3x3, 7x5, and 25x5 DiNapoli set as optional overlays. Negative values center the line for research, and the dashboard says plainly when no live value exists under the newest bars.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Displacement
indicators.description: Flags displacement legs: runs of one-directional closes whose net travel clears 4x the average candle body of the last 40 bars, with a 60% body-efficiency floor and per-leg statistics in hover tooltips. Optional structure-shift, liquidity-sweep, and killzone filters attach the context SMC models demand before trusting a repricing.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Displacement Sweep Reversal
indicators.description: The Displacement Sweep Reversal with FVG indicator detects liquidity sweeps followed by a structural reversal supported by significant price displacement and a Fair Value Gap. Traders use this tool to identify high probability entry zones by monitoring when price breaks a key swing level after a liquidity grab. The indicator highlights the entry window and FVG, helping users identify potential pullback trades that align with market structure shifts and algorithmic price delivery patterns.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Distribution Moments
indicators.description: Computes the shape of a rolling return distribution (mean, variance, standard deviation, skewness, and kurtosis) over 252 bars of log returns, plotting a chosen moment (skewness by default) while a dashboard reports all of them with tail reads. Alerts fire when skewness crosses ±0.5 or raw kurtosis clears 3, flagging asymmetry and fat tails for quantitative traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Divergence Variants & Confirmation
indicators.description: Detects regular, hidden, and exaggerated divergences on RSI, Stochastic %K, MACD, or Rate of Change, then tracks each through a pending-to-confirmed-or-failed state machine: structure-break confirmation by default with a 30-bar window. Variant labels, multiple-divergence chains, and a confirm-rate dashboard keep the grading honest.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Donchian Channels
indicators.description: Donchian Channels plot the highest high and lowest low over a 20-bar lookback as upper and lower bands, with a midline halfway between them; the same construction is often called a Price Channel. The bands mark the recent price extremes that breakout approaches reference. This is the raw standard calculation with the classic length of 20.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Donchian MA Bands
indicators.description: Donchian MA Bands runs highest/lowest channel logic on moving average values instead of raw price, drawing dynamic cloud zones that hug trends and double as support and resistance. Four display styles, nine MA options, and breakout dots when price clears the extremes. For trend traders who want smoother channels than raw highs and lows give.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Donchian Trend Rules
indicators.description: Runs the mechanical Donchian breakout system: long on a break of the prior 20-bar high, exit on the prior 10-bar low, mirrored for shorts, with close or intrabar triggers and one-sided or reversing direction modes. Plots the entry channel, a trailing exit level, and sequenced markers (one entry per trade) for systematic trend followers.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Donchian Width
indicators.description: Plots the span between Donchian channel extremes (the 20-bar highest high minus lowest low, normalized to the channel midline by default) with an optional 55-bar slow width. Percentile ranking over the last 100 bars flags compression at the 20th percentile and stretched extremes at the 80th, giving breakout traders a screenable volatility regime read.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Donchian Zig-Zag
indicators.description: Donchian Zig-Zag draws a line that bounces between Donchian channel extremes, recreating zig-zag behavior with a tunable bounce speed. Slow it down for a lagging trend line that crosses price at potential entries, or speed it up for a leading, projective read. Its extended peaks and troughs double as support and resistance references.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Double Bollinger Zones
indicators.description: Draws two Bollinger Band pairs on one 20-period basis (inner at 1 standard deviation, outer at 2), partitioning the chart into buy, sell, and neutral zones. A regime qualifies after 2 consecutive closes hold a zone, with pullback-hold, zone-loss, and full-traverse alerts plus a dashboard reporting zone, regime, closes, and depth. A trend-following regime map for any market.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Double Stochastic
indicators.description: Runs the stochastic calculation twice: Bressert's two-pass %K by default (10/3 per stage), or Blau's double-smoothed components, producing a 0-100 oscillator that visits its 80/20 extremes rarely and deliberately. Gradient-filled around the 50 midline with level-cross and extreme-turn alerts, it suits swing traders confirming faster triggers.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Double-bottom Base
indicators.description: Traces the W-shaped growth-stock base from confirmed swings: two sell-offs where the second low undercuts the first, depth, mid-peak and prior-uptrend checks, and a buy point set above the middle peak. Breakouts require expanded volume, a handle variant can tighten the entry, and a dashboard grades base proportions plus the volume character of the lows and right side.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Dow Theory
indicators.description: Classifies the primary and secondary trend from confirmed swing structure, labeling each pivot HH, HL, LH or LL and flagging failure-swing reversals, with volume confirmation, an optional confirmation index and a market-phase dashboard. Defaults read primary swings 20 bars wide and secondary swings 5, judged on closing prices. For trend traders who want the classic tenets made mechanical.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: DR/IDR Candles
indicators.description: DR/IDR Candles plots the defining range and implied defining range of two configurable sessions as clean range candles, color-coded blue, gray, or orange by where price sits against the range. Optional Fibonacci retracements project pullback levels from either range. Built for session traders applying the DR/IDR rule set to the morning or overnight window.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Dragonfly Doji
indicators.description: Flags the T-shaped dragonfly doji with quantified filters: body at most 5% of the bar range, upper shadow capped at 10%, and a lower shadow at least twice the body and one ATR long. A prior decline is required by default, and each bullish signal is tracked through a three-bar confirmation window with trigger and stop levels drawn at the body top and shadow low.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Draw on Liquidity
indicators.description: Inventories untapped liquidity pools (prior week and day highs/lows, session extremes, equal highs/lows, swing points and unfilled gaps) and names the working draw: the highest-scoring pool on the structure-bias side, weighted by tier and ATR distance. A magnet gradient, pool labels, dashboard and sweep alerts keep the target read current.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: DSS Bressert
indicators.description: A double-smoothed stochastic: the stochastic normalization runs twice with EMA smoothing after each pass (13/13/8 defaults), producing a 0-100 oscillator that moves quickly between extremes and pauses there. Ships with a signal line, 80/20 levels with hook detection at the extremes, a midline gradient fill, and alerts for hooks, signal crosses and level entries.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: DTFX Algo Zones
indicators.description: DTFX Algo Zones auto-draws Fibonacci retracement zones from market structure shifts, anchoring each zone from the broken swing to the extreme reached after the break. Up to five customizable fib levels per zone map where pullbacks may react. For structure traders who want retracements placed by rule rather than by hand.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Dynamic Delta FVG
indicators.description: Dynamic Delta FVG detects fair value gaps and splits each one into green and red segments showing the exact buy and sell volume share from lower-timeframe data. Live B%/S% tags, volume and volatility filters, and an aggregate delta dashboard grade every imbalance. For order-flow traders who want conviction behind each gap.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Dynamic Momentum Index
indicators.description: Chande and Kroll's variable-length RSI: the 14-period base is divided by a volatility index (5-bar standard deviation over its 10-bar average) and clamped between 5 and 30 bars, so readings turn faster in volatile phases and steadier in quiet ones. Plots the adaptive oscillator with 70/30 levels, a midline gradient, an optional effective-length stepline and a dashboard.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Dynamic Order Blocks
indicators.description: Dynamic Order Blocks keeps the most recent unmitigated bullish and bearish order block on the chart, plus the average level between them as an adaptive support/resistance line. Mitigation breaks hint at trend direction, and bordered boxes mark level sweeps: failed breakouts that can precede reversals. A minimal, always-current order block read for price action traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Dynamic Time Warping Similarity
indicators.description: Searches history for the windows whose shape most resembles the last 30 bars, comparing z-normalized windows with dynamic time warping under a Sakoe-Chiba band. The closest non-overlapping analogs are boxed on the chart with optional aftermath zones showing what followed, ranked in a dashboard by DTW distance, with alerts when the best match crosses the strong-match threshold.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Ease of Movement
