Each profile keeps the value areas and developing POC line, and adds buyside and sellside liquidity zones for supply-and-demand context.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Liquidity Structure & Order Flow
indicators.description: Liquidity Structure & Order Flow fuses a volume profile, per-bin delta coloring, and liquidity-void detection into one view of where the market is heavy, who is aggressive, and where price can slip fast. Z-score volume bubbles, dynamic volume ribbons, and a metrics dashboard round it out for day, swing, and scalp traders alike.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Liquidity Sweeps
indicators.description: Detects liquidity sweeps of swing-based liquidity levels and boxes the swept range as a tradable Sweep Area. Wick-only raids print as dotted lines and break-and-retest events as dashed lines, so a stop hunt is never confused with a clean breakout. Built for traders who fade raids at prior highs and lows or wait for the retest to confirm.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Liquidity Swings
indicators.description: Maps swing highs and lows as liquidity-rich zones, labeling each with how many times price has revisited it and how much volume traded inside. Count and volume filters strip out minor levels, leaving only the areas where orders genuinely cluster. A retrospective analysis tool for framing support, resistance, and accumulation zones.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Liquidity Voids (FVG)
indicators.description: Detects liquidity voids (stretches of price the market skipped during sharp one-sided moves) using fair value gap logic, and shades each bullish or bearish void at its exact range. Since voids tend to fill, the zones double as magnets and reaction areas for retracement trades. An ATR-based threshold keeps insignificant gaps off the chart.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Livermore Pivotal Point
indicators.description: Livermore Pivotal Point keeps the Market Key on the chart: a six-column price record with percent-scaled thresholds (default 6%) that underlines rally and reaction extremes as pivotal points, then tracks every break for 3% follow-through or a danger-signal failure. Levels, break markers, danger crosses and a ledger table for structure traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Logistic Signal Calibration
indicators.description: Logistic Signal Calibration fuses three z-scored features - momentum (14), trend (50) and volume flow (20) - through a logistic model into a 0-to-1 probability-style score with decision thresholds at 0.7 and 0.3. A reliability dashboard grades each score against its 10-bar outcome, tracking hit rate, average confidence, Brier score and overconfidence.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Long Wick Detector
indicators.description: Flags candles whose wicks stretch beyond a volatility threshold you set, marking the exact levels where price was rejected hardest. Each long-wick level is tracked as mitigated or unmitigated and candles recolor as levels come into play, building a live map of rejection zones for reversal, supply-and-demand, and liquidity-grab setups.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Long-horizon Calendar Cycles
indicators.description: Long-horizon Calendar Cycles buckets completed calendar years by presidential term, decennial digit, the Benner schedule or a custom fixed-year cycle, plotting the current bucket's historical mean return as a tilt line with every year's actual outcome dotted around it. A cycle-map table with small-sample warnings keeps multi-year seasonality honest.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Low-resistance vs High-resistance Liquidity Runs
indicators.description: Maps the corridor between price and its nearest unswept liquidity pools - 30-bar major swings by default - and classifies each run low-resistance, mixed or high-resistance by counting intact 10-bar swings and opposing fair value gaps in the path. Delivery is graded by an efficiency ratio, and seven alerts cover reclassifications, pool sweeps and a failing low-resistance premise.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: LTF Momentum Projection
indicators.description: Projects a run of lower-timeframe candles beside your main chart, exposing the intra-bar action hidden inside each higher-timeframe candle. Thrust-and-exhaustion logic prints momentum-shift triangles on both the projection and the main chart, so scalpers can time entries from micro-structure without ever switching timeframes.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Luminance Breakout Engine
indicators.description: A momentum engine that blends fast, medium, slow, and macro rate-of-change into one composite oscillator, then flags Glow zones when it breaks adaptive volatility bands. Every Glow breakout also stamps a Luminance Order Block at the move's origin with a bullish-versus-bearish volume split, pairing breakout timing with order-flow context.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: MA Envelope
indicators.description: MA Envelope plots a moving average with upper and lower bands offset by a fixed percentage above and below it, defaulting to 2.5 percent. The center line's type is selectable, and the bands frame how far price has stretched from the average. This is the standard envelope construction with no modifications.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: MA of MA
indicators.description: Overlay that smooths a moving average with a second moving average, defaulting to a 20-period EMA fed into another 20-period EMA across six selectable average types. A dashboard totals each pass's nominal lag in bars, an optional lag-reduced line cancels most of it, and crossings fire turn alerts. For trend traders who want a stable baseline with its lag quantified.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: MA Sabres
indicators.description: Monitors the slope of a chosen moving average and, when a persistent run finally flips direction, projects a curved sabre from the latest extreme. Each blade's angle scales with 14-period ATR volatility and serves as support or resistance, a breakout line, and a stop-loss marker. Eight MA types let you tune how reversals are detected.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: MACD
indicators.description: MACD computes the difference between a fast and a slow exponential moving average of the source, plotting the MACD line together with an EMA signal line and a histogram of the gap between them. Defaults follow the classic 12/26/9 configuration on a selectable source. This is the standard implementation of Appel's Moving Average Convergence Divergence with no modifications.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: MACD Based Price Forecasting
indicators.description: Turns MACD signals into forward projections: each time a signal fires, the tool recalls how price traveled after comparable past signals and plots a percentile-based forecast path inside a shaded expected range. Switch trend detection between MACD polarity and signal-line crosses, tilt the central path bullish or bearish, and read the band edges as support and resistance candidates.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: MACD-V
indicators.description: Volatility-normalized MACD: the 12/26 EMA spread divided by a 26-period ATR and scaled to percent, with a 9-period signal line, histogram and fixed lifecycle levels at +/-50 and +/-150. Crosses, zone changes and overextension entries are all alertable. For momentum traders who want one set of reference levels that reads the same on any symbol or timeframe.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Machine Learning Moving Average
indicators.description: A moving average rebuilt on Gaussian process regression, tunable from long-horizon smoothness to fast reaction through its Window and Forecast inputs. The line recolors with the estimated trend, bands frame the range price is likely to travel, and colored circles mark turning points whenever price escapes the bands.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Machine Learning Regression Trend
indicators.description: Fits a linear regression channel using RANSAC, a machine-learning routine that repeatedly re-fits on random samples and keeps the model that best ignores outliers. The result is a trend channel anchored to genuine structure rather than volatile spikes, with flagged outliers doubling as a noise gauge and the fit projecting forward as a forecast.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Machine Learning Trendlines Cluster
indicators.description: The Machine Learning Trendlines Cluster draws trendlines algorithmically: k-means clustering groups price into trading ranges, and a linear regression through each cluster becomes a line on the chart. Choose how many lines to detect and filter them by slope: objective trendlines without manual drawing, for traders who distrust hand-picked pivots.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Machine Learning: Anchored Gaussian Process Regression
indicators.description: Gaussian process regression trained on exactly the slice of history you choose: drop two anchors on the chart and the model fits only the bars between them, then projects a forecast forward. Smooth and Sigma shape the fit and its amplitude, while a mean-price line benchmarks how far the forecast strays from the training window's average.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Machine Learning: Gaussian Process Regression
indicators.description: Applies Gaussian process regression to a rolling window of recent prices, drawing a denoised estimate of the underlying trend and projecting it a chosen number of bars ahead. Three update modes keep the forecast locked, refresh it when its horizon completes, or recompute it every bar: a flexible trend lens for forecast-minded traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: MAMA/FAMA
indicators.description: Plots Ehlers' MESA adaptive pair: MAMA retunes its smoothing factor every bar from the dominant cycle phase between a 0.5 Fast Limit and a 0.05 Slow Limit, with FAMA trailing at half that factor as the signal line. The pair colors by cross state under a gradient fill. For trend followers who want crossovers that sit flat through cyclic chop and jump with breakouts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Breadth Toolkit
indicators.description: The Market Breadth Toolkit packs six classic breadth thrust measures (from Zweig's Breadth Thrust to Deemer's Breakaway Momentum and Whaley's volume thrusts) into one tool, each computable on NYSE or NASDAQ data for twelve market-wide reads. Divergence detection and adjustable fixed levels turn raw participation counts into concrete signals.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Maker Models
indicators.description: Tracks the full ICT market maker schematic: original consolidation, displaced leg away with interior consolidations mapped, smart money reversal at the curve extreme, and a return leg that consumes the mapped zones as targets. Defaults detect 15-bar ranges within 2 ATR and 1-ATR displacement on both buy and sell models. For traders who want the whole delivery curve staged and labeled.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Performance by Yearly Seasons
indicators.description: Market Performance by Yearly Seasons charts an asset's average return in each of the four seasons across a decade of history, highlighting the current season for instant orientation. Hemisphere selection plus meteorological or astronomical boundaries keep the seasonal frame accurate, and a raw per-year view separates repeatable patterns from outliers.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Sentiment Technicals
indicators.description: Market Sentiment Technicals condenses a full panel of classic techniques (momentum oscillators, trend tools, and market structure) into one normalized sentiment value. A per-indicator histogram panel, a sentiment meter, and an oscillator with divergence detection reveal at a glance whether conditions lean bullish, bearish, or sideways.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market State Matrix
indicators.description: The Market State Matrix compresses trend, momentum, volatility, volume, and price structure into one radial dashboard: five concentric rings crossed by twelve lookback slices spanning 8 to 220 bars. Aligned colors signal confluence, mixed slices expose internal conflict, and a phase highlighter tags expansion, exhaustion, contraction, or accumulation.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Structure (Breakers)
indicators.description: Market Structure (Breakers) extends every broken swing level forward as a 'breaker structure': a dotted line that may act as support or resistance after the break. Candle borders flag each test, lifespan rules decide how many breaks a level survives, and breakouts at trend extremities warn of possible reversals ahead.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Structure (Intrabar)
indicators.description: Market Structure (Intrabar) looks inside every chart candle and rebuilds the market structure playing out on a lower timeframe within it, labeling intrabar CHoCH and BoS in real time. A statistics dashboard counts each formation, revealing whether one trend dominates beneath the bar or its interior is churning with shifts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Structure & Fibonacci Zones + RR
indicators.description: Market Structure & Fibonacci Zones + RR detects breaks of structure, projects the 50-61.8% golden pocket behind each one, and waits for price to confirm inside the zone before drawing an automatic risk/reward box: stop at the origin of the trend, target at your chosen ratio. A complete, systematic pullback-entry workflow on a single chart.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Structure & Scatter Dashboard
indicators.description: Market Structure & Scatter Dashboard pairs BOS and CHoCH labels with a scatter plot that maps every price impulse against the pullback that followed, in percentage terms. Quadrant position and color-coded magnitude expose momentum shifts and overextension, while an optional heatmap paints candles with the live impulse and pullback readings.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Structure Break & OB Probability Toolkit
indicators.description: The Market Structure Break & OB Probability Toolkit validates structure breaks with a momentum Z-Score, then maps the order blocks behind them (Point of Control included) and grades every zone, promoting those scoring above 80% to high-probability status. Session ranges and a live reliability dashboard add quantitative discipline to SMC trading.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Structure CHoCH/BOS (Fractal)
indicators.description: Market Structure CHoCH/BOS (Fractal) maps market structure from fractal patterns rather than swing points, printing more frequent, adaptive CHoCH and BOS labels. Optional support and resistance levels track each structure's extremes, and a dashboard reports the share of fractals that resolve into structure: an experimental angle, openly framed.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Structure Oscillator
indicators.description: The Market Structure Oscillator scores structure shifts and breaks across short, intermediate, and long-term swings, then blends them into one weighted oscillator with a companion cycle histogram. Equilibrium crosses, extreme readings, and divergences translate raw structure labels into momentum signals tuned to your preferred horizon.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Structure Targets Model
indicators.description: Projects horizontal price targets from confirmed market structure events, measuring each MSS or MSB leg and extending it by your chosen percentage. Independent bullish and bearish distances suit take-profits, reversal confirmation, or support and resistance, while stale targets expire automatically. Built for traders who plan exits around structure.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Structure Trailing Stop
indicators.description: A trailing stop driven by market structure: it resets to the prior trend's extreme whenever a CHoCH (or optionally any BOS) prints, then converges toward price at a speed set by the Increment Factor. Structure labels stay on the chart as it works. For trend traders who want exits managed by the same events that time their entries.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Structure Volume Distribution
indicators.description: Pairs swing-based market structure detection with a buy/sell volume profile so every structure break can be weighed by the participation behind it. A grid of up to 100 equal rows ties each break to its profile row and doubles as automatic support and resistance. For traders who refuse to take a breakout at face value.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Market Structure with Inducements & Sweeps
indicators.description: Labels market structure the way discretionary SMC traders mark it by hand: CHoCH and BOS detection refined by mandatory inducements between phases, plus sweep detection that separates wicked levels from true breaks. Structure and inducement periods are independently tunable. For price action traders who want charts marked with markup discipline.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Markup & Markdown
indicators.description: Dates the trending phases of the Wyckoff cycle from structure: a compressed range capped at 3.5x ATR must break on widening spread and expanding volume, with the phase confirming only once the first reaction holds. Stride steps, volume character, a phase background and a dashboard track each phase's health, with nine alerts from range exit to character warnings.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Marubozu
indicators.description: Detects full, opening and closing marubozu candles under a 3% wick tolerance, requiring bodies above the 20-bar typical range with optional volume and trend filters. Detections are colored and tagged, and the latest candle leaves a high/low/midpoint frame with absorption alerts. For candlestick readers who want conviction bars flagged only when they are big enough to matter.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Mass Index
indicators.description: Mass Index sums the ratio of a 9-period EMA of the high-low range to a double 9-period EMA of that range over a 25-bar window, producing an oscillator that rises as the trading range widens. It is traditionally read for the reversal bulge pattern, where the index climbs above 27 and then drops below 26.5. Defaults match Donald Dorsey's original specification (length 25 with the EMA-9 ratio sum), implemented here in its standard unmodified form.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Master Pattern
indicators.description: Detects Wyckoff-inspired contraction phases (a lower high against a higher low) and draws the expansion line whose break defines bullish and bearish master patterns, graded major or minor. Liquidity levels from historical pivots supply target and stop references. For traders who work the contraction-to-expansion rhythm.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Matching Low/high
indicators.description: Marks matching lows and highs (two adjacent same-direction closes agreeing within a tolerance of 5% of ATR by default, after a 14-bar trend context) then extends the matched close with its tolerance band until a decisive close resolves the level as held or broken. A dashboard tallies both outcomes on the loaded chart, and six alerts cover detection and resolution.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Matrix Profile
indicators.description: Computes a full matrix profile self-join over the last 400 bars: every 24-bar window's z-normalized distance to its nearest neighbor elsewhere in the sample, drawn as a companion series where valleys are repeated shapes and peaks are anomalies. Motif pairs and discords are boxed on the price chart, the newest window is paired with its closest analog, and three alerts flag motif matches, discords and the top anomaly.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Maximum-entropy Spectrum
indicators.description: Estimates the dominant market cycle with Burg's maximum-entropy method: a 12th-order autoregressive model is fitted to 64 conditioned samples each bar and its spectrum scanned over 8-48 bar periods. The smoothed dominant period plots as a line, the live spectrum draws as a heat profile beside the last bar, and alerts flag sharp or flat spectrum transitions and cycle shifts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: McDonald's Pattern
indicators.description: A tongue-in-cheek detector that fits cubic Bezier curves through recent tops and bottoms in search of the meme-famous golden-arches 'M'. A live score rates the resemblance, with red and green backgrounds flagging standard and inverted matches. Strictly entertainment: for traders whose charts could use a laugh between real setups.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Measured Move
indicators.description: Projects measured-move targets from confirmed swing structure: the A-B leg's size, in points or as a percentage ratio, projected from the correction end C into a target zone 10% of the projected distance wide. Labels report the target price and the implied reward-to-risk from C, finished second legs are measured against the projection, and six alerts track each construction.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Measured-move Up/down
indicators.description: Detects the measured-move up and down chart patterns from confirmed swings: a first trending leg, an orderly correction retracing 33-67% of it by default, then a second leg projected to match the first. Target, 50% partial objective and correction-extreme stop extend live until price settles the outcome, with eight alerts running from detection through completion or invalidation.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Midnight Open Retracement
indicators.description: Plots the 12:00 AM New York open and tracks whether the session retraces to it, setting bias automatically from where the 9:30 AM open sits relative to the level. A live dashboard reports historical retracement frequencies by weekday, compiled from Nasdaq 100 futures data. For intraday and ICT-style index futures traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Midpoint/half-back of Session
indicators.description: Plots the developing session half-back, (high + low) / 2, for up to three windows, defaulting to Asia, London and New York on UTC. Completed mids freeze and carry forward, acceptance is read from 2 consecutive closes, and every test of a level is counted and alertable. For intraday traders who judge control of the range by which side of the midpoint price accepts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: MLMA
indicators.description: Machine learning moving average built on causal Gaussian kernel regression: an 8.0-bandwidth kernel fits a 100-bar window into a non-repainting fitted mean with uncertainty bands at 2 residual standard deviations. Slope coloring, a stretch dashboard and band breakout and reversion alerts complete it. For traders who want an adaptive smoother whose envelope widens where the fit is unsure.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Model Stacking
indicators.description: Trains three small logistic models on momentum, mean-reversion and volume/volatility features, then blends their stored out-of-fold predictions through a ridge-regularized meta-learner into one stacked probability plotted from 0 to 100%. A dashboard reports each base model's learned weight and out-of-sample hit rate, and four alerts cover the 60/40 thresholds and midline crosses.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Momentum Cycle Sentry
indicators.description: A mirrored momentum oscillator that wraps a symmetric cloud around a zero line: width tracks trend velocity, teal and coral carry the bias, and a neon glow traces each retracement back toward equilibrium. Standard-deviation corridors replace fixed overbought and oversold lines. For trend and pullback traders who want cycles made visible.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Momentum Expansion vs Contraction
indicators.description: Recasts six oscillators (MACD histogram by default) as one zero-centered histogram and labels momentum expansion versus contraction two ways: bar-to-bar streaks confirmed over 3 bars, and swing-to-swing comparison of 5-bar peaks and troughs. Connectors, markers and a lifecycle dashboard surface the read. For traders who want deceleration flagged before price bends.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Momentum Terrain 3D
indicators.description: Renders RSI as a 3D landscape: a whole range of lookback lengths across recent history forms a surface whose height is momentum, with a neutral plane at 50 and colored pillars marking overbought and oversold extremes. Slopes reveal alignment, pullbacks, and compression at a glance. For traders who want the whole momentum picture, not one line.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Monday Range
indicators.description: Marks Monday's high, low and midpoint once the session completes and extends them to Friday as the week's reference frame, with a range fill, level labels and up to 5 archived past weeks. The session boundary is configurable (exchange day or a fixed timezone) and six alerts cover the range being set, breaks, failed breaks and midpoint crosses.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Money Flow Index
indicators.description: Money Flow Index is a volume-weighted oscillator bounded between 0 and 100 that compares positive and negative money flow, computed from typical price multiplied by volume over a lookback window. Defaults follow the classic configuration: length 14 with overbought and oversold reference levels at 80 and 20. The calculation is the standard published formula with no modifications.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Money Flow Profile
indicators.description: A three-part profile stacking traded activity, buy/sell sentiment, and key price levels side by side, sourced from volume or money flow over a lookback or fixed range. High-activity nodes expose support and resistance, while heatmap and consolidation-zone options sharpen the read. For traders mapping where money actually changed hands.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Monte Carlo Expected Move Distribution
indicators.description: Runs up to 500 Geometric Brownian Motion simulations and condenses them into a forward histogram: median outcome, one-standard-deviation expected move, and low-probability tails. Targets, stops, and invalidation levels become probability decisions instead of guesses. For swing, intraday, and options-minded traders who plan in ranges.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Monte Carlo Mean Reversion Heatmap
indicators.description: Projects 100+ simulated price paths as a forward probability heatmap and scores how many revert to an EMA within the window, turning 'price looks stretched' into a measurable percentage. Percentile lines at 5, 50, and 95 frame statistical extremes. For mean-reversion and volatility traders who want odds instead of opinions.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Monte Carlo Shuffled Projection
indicators.description: Projects a fan of possible price paths by shuffling the bar-to-bar changes from a recent lookback window and compounding them forward from the last close. Runs up to 1,000 simulations, distilling them into an Average Line with standard-deviation bands that frame probable territory. Built for traders who want probabilistic context instead of single-line forecasts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Moon Phases Strategy
indicators.description: A calendar-driven strategy that times entries to the lunar cycle, buying new moons and selling full moons by default, with conditions you can invert or switch to higher/lower-moon trend-following. The cycle is approximated at 29.53 days, so higher timeframes keep the phase math honest. A clean sandbox for testing whether lunar seasonality holds on your market.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Morning Star
indicators.description: Detects the three-candle morning star reversal with measurable rules: outer candles sized against a 14-bar average body, a small star, and a third close reclaiming at least 50% of the first body. A 50-bar SMA downtrend filter is on by default, and each pattern is framed by dashed trigger and stop levels. Built for candlestick traders who want objective, chart-marked detections.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Motive Wave
indicators.description: Counts completed five-wave motive structures on a 10-bar ZigZag swing base, keeping only counts that pass the Elliott hard rules and classifying each as impulse or diagonal. Numbered labels carry ratio measurements, a developing count projects the presumed fifth wave with its invalidation level, and an RSI comparison flags fifth-wave momentum divergence.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Moving Average
indicators.description: A single configurable moving average that smooths a chosen price source over a set lookback and plots the result on the chart, with a default length of 20. A type selector covers the common variants: SMA (default), EMA, WMA, RMA/SMMA, HMA, ALMA, VWMA, DEMA, TEMA, KAMA, LSMA, McGinley Dynamic, and Hamming, plus an optional second moving average with cross alerts. Each type follows its standard published formula with no added logic.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Moving Average Converging
indicators.description: A moving average that speeds up as a trend proves itself: every new higher high or lower low tightens its smoothing factor, so the line converges toward price the longer a move lasts. Paired with a fast MA for earlier crossovers than fixed-length equivalents, it behaves like a cross between a slow moving average and a trailing Parabolic SAR.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Moving Averages Proximity Oscillator
indicators.description: Compresses a whole span of SMA lengths into two oscillator readings: how many of the averages price sits above, and which average is nearest to price right now. The first gauges trend strength on an optionally normalized 0-100 scale; the second flags reversals brewing as price gravitates back toward longer-term averages. A Smooth input steadies both outputs.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: MSS Sweep Fib Retrace
indicators.description: Chains three institutional footprints into one setup: a sweep of a prior swing level, a momentum-confirmed market structure shift, and a pullback to the 50% retracement of the sweep leg. Entries print with ATR-sized stop and target zones, and an optional 200 EMA macro filter keeps signals aligned with the higher trend. For traders who wait for confirmation rather than the first break.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: MSS Sweeps
indicators.description: MSS Sweeps identifies internal market structure liquidity sweeps, specifically targeting higher low and lower high pivot points. By calculating internal market structure breaks, the indicator isolates protected levels established after a trend confirmation. It alerts traders when these levels are swept and subsequently reclaimed, signaling potential continuation trades that align with established market structure. It is designed for traders utilizing structural order flow strategies.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Multi Ranges Volume Distribution
indicators.description: Stacks up to three volume profiles on one chart (daily, weekly, and monthly by default) each marking its range high, range low, and point of control. Rows can show total volume or a buy/sell split color-graded by delta, exposing which side absorbed the trading at every price. For traders who read short- and long-term acceptance levels side by side.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Multi Timeframe Market Formation
indicators.description: Classifies live market structure into five formations (bullish, bearish, contraction, expansion, sideways) on your chart timeframe and up to five higher ones simultaneously. Labels and a trailing channel intensify as timeframes synchronize, and shared boundary levels stack onto single lines that double as high-interest support and resistance.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Multi-Chart Widget
indicators.description: Docks up to three mini charts beside your main chart, each with its own symbol, timeframe, and style: candles, volume candles, line, area, Heikin Ashi, and more. Overlay Supertrend, moving averages, or Bollinger Bands per chart, while a statistics panel tracks Dual Supertrend, RSI, volatility, and R-squared for every instrument. Multi-market context without switching layouts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Multi-Length Stochastic Average
indicators.description: Averages stochastic oscillators of every length from 4 up to your chosen maximum into a single 0-100 line, so one reading reflects price's position inside every rolling high-low range in the span at once. Prints 0 at all rolling lows and 100 at all rolling highs, with circles marking 20/80 crossings and pre- and post-smoothing configurable at each stage.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Murrey Math Levels
indicators.description: Draws the full Murrey Math octave ladder from a 64-bar frame, snapping the range onto the published power-of-ten scale and labeling every rung from -2/8 to +2/8 with its conventional role. The grid re-anchors when a frame completes or price escapes the overshoot lines, prior ladders stay for validation, and alerts cover the 4/8 pivot, both extremes, and the reversal rungs.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: N Bar Reversal Detector
indicators.description: Generalizes the classic three-bar reversal to any sequence length: N-1 bars set the prevailing push, and the Nth bar breaking the first bar's extreme flags the turn, with an Enhanced mode demanding a close beyond it. Confirmed patterns project support and resistance, and MA cloud, Supertrend, or Donchian filters align signals with or against the trend.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Nadaraya-Watson Envelope
indicators.description: Wraps a kernel-regression estimate of the underlying trend in bands offset by mean absolute deviation, flagging stretched prices for contrarian trading. Triangles and alerts fire when price crosses an envelope extremity, and a non-repainting endpoint mode makes it behave like a traditional band indicator; the default smoothing repaints by design.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Nadaraya-Watson Smoothers
indicators.description: The Nadaraya-Watson Smoothers fit a Gaussian kernel regression through price, with smoothness set by a bandwidth input instead of a window length. Toggle between a non-repainting endpoint estimate that reads like a moving average and a repainting fit that labels every directional turn, built for traders who study trend structure.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Naked POC
indicators.description: Builds a profile for every completed period and tracks its point of control forward as a naked POC until price trades back through it. Daily sessions split into 24 rows by default, with the POC weighted by volume or by time (TPO) for symbols without volume. Levels fade with age, carry date tags, and alerts fire when a new NPOC appears or an old one is tested.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Negative Volume Index
indicators.description: The definitive clean build of the Negative Volume Index: a cumulative line that updates only on sessions with falling volume, compounding each quiet day's percentage close change, paired with the conventional 255-period signal EMA. Regime coloring and a gradient fill show at a glance whether NVI holds above or below its average, with alerts on both crosses.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Neighboring Trailing Stop
indicators.description: The Neighboring Trailing Stop builds a ratcheting stop-loss from the local distribution of recent prices, using k-nearest neighbors selection and a percentile filter instead of ATR multiples. Green and red regimes track trend direction while B and S labels mark structural reversals: a data-driven exit engine for swing, intraday, and systematic traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: NeoWave Logic
indicators.description: Applies Glenn Neely's rule-bound wave discipline to confirmed swings: every adjacent wave pair is measured in price and time against a 33% similarity threshold, structures are labeled as :5 impulsive, :3 corrective, triangles including the neutral variant, or diametrics, and each label is then held to its post-pattern expectation until confirmed or invalidated.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: NFP Price Zones
indicators.description: NFP Price Zones prepares a chart for Non-Farm Payrolls by projecting expansion zones from the statistics of past releases and freezing them 30 minutes before the print. Historical reaction boxes plus a dashboard tracking average range, directional expansion, and a live countdown give news traders in forex, indices, gold, and crypto a structured plan.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Nine Buying/selling Tests
indicators.description: Audits a suspected accumulation base or distribution top against the classic Wyckoff checklist: prior trend fulfilled, climax with a lighter-volume secondary test, activity, stride-line break, stepping lows and highs, relative strength versus SP:SPX, cause size and a 3:1 reward/risk objective. A live table scores all nine tests, with range box, stride line and objective level drawn.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: No-demand / No-supply Bars
indicators.description: Tags VSA no-demand and no-supply bars as they complete: an up or down close on a spread below the 20-bar average with volume under both prior bars. A 50-period EMA background filter qualifies each detection against trend context, out-of-context prints show as faded ghost tags, and triangles mark the next-bar confirmations VSA waits for before acting.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: No-Wick Retest Levels
indicators.description: The No-Wick Retest Levels indicator detects price levels formed by candles with little to no wick at the high or low, signaling strong directional momentum. When price returns to these levels, the indicator highlights a retest opportunity, filtered by a 1-minute EMA trend. Once a level is tapped, it manages an ATR-based trade setup with specific take-profit and stop-loss targets. Traders use this tool to identify high-interest zones where momentum was previously exhausted or confirmed.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Normalized Oscillators Spider Chart
indicators.description: The Normalized Oscillators Spider Chart overlays a radial spider chart beside price, giving eight normalized oscillators (RSI, %K, MFI, WPR, CMO, Aroon and more) one shared view with a dashed median reference. Its sentiment meter averages the spokes into a single trend-versus-range reading, for traders who want a full oscillator panel without extra panes.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Normalized Resonator
indicators.description: The Normalized Resonator isolates a chosen market cycle with a second-order bandpass filter, then normalizes the output against its rolling peak so overbought and oversold levels hold across any symbol or timeframe. Signal-line crossovers at the extremes print reversal labels: for cycle traders, mean-reversion systems, and anyone outgrowing fixed-length oscillators.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: NR4 & NR7 with Breakouts
indicators.description: NR4 & NR7 with Breakouts flags Toby Crabel's narrow-range bars (a range tighter than the three or six bars before it) boxing each pattern and extending its range as live levels. A close beyond the range fires a directional breakout signal with reset logic tied to the range mean, giving compression-and-expansion traders a mechanical, testable setup.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: NRTR
indicators.description: A clean build of Kopyrkin's Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse: a stop-and-reverse line held 2% beneath the running high of an up state or above the running low of a down state, ratcheting only in the trend's favor. An ATR mode (length 14, multiplier 3) sizes the same construction by volatility, with reversal markers, a gradient trail fill, and flip alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: O'Neil Base Analysis
indicators.description: Implements the base-trading rules of William O'Neil's growth-stock method: consolidations are validated against a 30% prior uptrend, 5-bar minimum length and 33% depth cap, the pivot buy point sits just above resistance, breakouts demand a 40% volume surge, base stages are counted with late-stage flags, and the 7% base-failure stop is enforced. Eight alerts cover the cycle.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: OBV Divergence
indicators.description: Detects regular and hidden divergences between price and On-Balance Volume at confirmed swing points, using 5-bar pivots on both sides and a 60-bar cap between compared swings. Divergence lines draw in the OBV pane and on the price chart, Bull and Bear labels mark the confirming swing, and drawn signals do not repaint once printed.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Omni-Flow Consensus
indicators.description: Omni-Flow Consensus is a momentum and liquidity oscillator that scores the conviction behind each move, blending candle structure, directional flow, and volume-weighted aggression into one normalized -100 to +100 line. Regime colors, diamond Flow Injection markers, and gradient candles make it a participation filter for trend and breakout traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: On Balance Volume
indicators.description: On Balance Volume keeps a cumulative running total of volume, adding each bar's volume when the close is higher than the prior close and subtracting it when the close is lower, plotted as a single line used to compare volume flow with price movement. The build is cumulative from the first available bar and includes an optional smoothing moving average overlay. It is Joe Granville's indicator in its standard unmodified form.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: On-Chain Analysis
indicators.description: On-Chain Analysis plots blockchain fundamentals beneath a crypto chart: wallet profitability, exchange and miner flows, on-chain volume, active addresses, MVRV, TVL, social sentiment, holder composition, and more. One selectable metric at a time, with smoothing and a signal line. For crypto traders who want network evidence behind every price move.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: On-Chain Signals
indicators.description: On-Chain Signals distills four blockchain metrics (Net Network Growth, In the Money, Concentration, and Large Transactions) into a single bullish, bearish, or neutral market bias. Read it as a gauge, as historical plots, or as a smoothed average, with thresholds adjustable per signal: a daily-timeframe sentiment compass for crypto traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: On-neck / In-neck / Thrusting
indicators.description: Detects the three weak-rally continuation lines of a downtrend (on-neck closing near the prior low, in-neck marginally above the prior close, thrusting into the body but short of its midpoint) after a long dark candle, labels each with its recovery depth, and tracks every pattern to a confirmed break of the pattern low or an invalidating push above the second candle's high.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: One-shot-one-kill
indicators.description: Stages the ICT One Shot One Kill weekly model on intraday charts: an auto or manual weekly bias, a raid of prior-week or session liquidity that fails to hold, a displacement structure shift, then a single entry at the 62-79% OTE retracement, one campaign per week. Killzone gating, stop and target framing, and a discipline panel keep the sequence honest.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: One-timeframing
indicators.description: Audits completed periods for one-timeframing (successive bars holding the prior period's opposite extreme) on the chart timeframe and a higher 30-minute bracket. Plots rolling invalidation levels, colors bars, marks sequence breaks, and summarizes state, streak, and level in a dashboard. Built for auction-theory traders tracking who controls the market.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Open Interest Chart
indicators.description: The Open Interest Chart plots the percentage change of futures open interest as color-coded circles at the chart's edge: green when money enters a market, red when it leaves. It can watch up to six futures tickers at once, including COT report data, giving futures traders a one-glance dashboard of participation across markets.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Open Interest Inflows & Outflows
indicators.description: Open Interest Inflows & Outflows measures whether changes in open interest come from new positions arriving or old ones closing, plotting an OI flow sentiment oscillator beside an Elder-Ray-based price sentiment line. A rolling correlation against user-selected data validates trends and flags divergences for derivatives traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Opening Range with Breakouts & Targets
indicators.description: Opening Range with Breakouts & Targets plots each session's opening range, fires breakout arrows when price escapes it, and projects a ladder of targets sized as a percentage of the range's width. A prior-day bias filter, custom time windows, and a session-resetting moving average complete an opening-range toolkit for intraday traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Order Block Detector
indicators.description: Detects bullish and bearish order blocks from confirmed volume pivots, marking the zones where large orders concentrated before a move. Mitigated blocks are hidden automatically using wick or close logic, and alerts cover both creation and mitigation. Built for price-action traders who want volume-backed zones instead of eyeballed rectangles.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Order Blocks & Breaker Blocks
indicators.description: Plots order blocks from swing points and keeps tracking them after price breaks through, flagging the moment a zone flips into a breaker block. Live blocks appear as solid areas, breakers as dashed dual-colored zones, with display counts for each side under your control. Suited to traders who trade polarity flips as well as fresh zones.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Order Flow VWAP Deviation
indicators.description: A market-structure toolkit layering VWAP deviation bands, pivot-based Stop Zones with stop-run detection, an anchored volume profile with POC and buyer/seller bias, and optional Inversion Fair Value Gaps. Built for intraday and swing traders who trade liquidity sweeps, mean reversion, and the levels where volume actually changed hands.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Oscillator of Oscillator
indicators.description: Runs a stochastic second layer over a selectable first-layer oscillator, RSI, Stochastic %K, CCI, MFI, or Rate of Change, locating it inside its own 14-bar range and smoothing the result into %K (3) and %D (3). Plots the pair with 80/20 extremes, a 50 midline, and a dashboard spelling out the two-pass pipeline. For traders wanting readable extremes from sluggish oscillators.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Oscillator Swing Failure
indicators.description: Runs a four-stage failure-swing state machine on RSI, Stochastic, CCI or MFI: an extreme pivot seeds the pattern, a lower high or higher low arms it, and a break of the fail point fires the signal. Ships with Auto thresholds per oscillator, pattern lines, a live watch level, a state dashboard and four alerts for traders who want momentum reversals confirmed by the indicator itself.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: OsMA
indicators.description: Plots OsMA (the spread between 12- and 26-period EMAs minus its 9-period signal line) as a four-state histogram separating growing from fading momentum on each side of zero. A sign flip across the dotted zero line is exactly a signal-line crossover, and alerts cover both crosses plus the first shrinking bar on either side. A clean build of the classic gauge.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Overnight & ETH Levels
indicators.description: Freezes the overnight session's high, low, and midpoint (ONH/ONL) and the pre-market extremes (PMH/PML) at the regular-session open, extends them across the day, and tracks each level as untested, tested, broken, or faded. Includes developing levels, a range fill, and a dashboard classifying the open against the overnight range. For intraday futures and stock traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Parabolic Phase
indicators.description: Confirms when a trend has bent into terminal acceleration: three consecutive impulse legs must each steepen by a 1.2 slope factor with rising structure and shrinking pullbacks, while price stretches to a 95th-percentile extreme from a 200-period average. Draws the steepening trendlines, tints the active phase, and marks the end with a labeled reason plus a 50% retracement level.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Parabolic SAR
indicators.description: Parabolic SAR plots a series of dots that trail price, accelerating toward it as a trend extends and flipping to the opposite side when price crosses the dots. It uses Wilder's standard parameters: a starting acceleration factor of 0.02, an increment of 0.02, and a maximum of 0.2. This is the raw textbook implementation without alterations.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Parabolic SAR Oscillator
indicators.description: Turns the Parabolic SAR trailing stop into a bounded oscillator, detrending price against the SAR and normalizing the result between -100 and 100. Extreme readings confirm the running trend while zero-line crosses give early reversal cues. A smooth, low-noise trend gauge for traders who prefer their SAR as an oscillator rather than dots on price.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Parallel Pivot Lines
indicators.description: Draws sets of parallel lines through past pivot highs and lows, every line sharing a slope you set between -1 and 1 via linear regression. Slope zero produces horizontal shelves; positive or negative values map sloped channels of support and resistance. A drawing-tool-like study for traders who want fixed reference levels that stay put.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Parkinson Estimator
indicators.description: Computes annualized Parkinson volatility from the high-low range over a 20-bar window, plotted beside close-to-close volatility on identical settings so the gap between the two lines diagnoses where movement happens. Percentile thresholds at 80/20 flag expansion and compression, with a dashboard for the ratio and rank. For sizing, bands, and volatility-regime work.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Participation Divergence at Index Highs
indicators.description: Grades every new index high against participation witnesses (the share of members above their 200-day average and an equal-weight ratio by default) and flags highs no witness confirms. Persistent divergence arms a regime that resolves as a repair or a structure break below the last swing low. For index traders watching breadth at the highs.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: PDH/L FVG (CRT)
indicators.description: The PDH/L FVG (CRT) indicator identifies key liquidity levels from previous daily highs and lows and combines them with Fair Value Gaps (FVG) to pinpoint potential institutional trading entries. By monitoring how price interacts with historical daily boundaries, this tool provides a systematic approach for traders to capture trend continuations following liquidity sweeps.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Peak Activity Range
indicators.description: Converts confirmed volume spikes into support and resistance ranges built from the spike candle's high and low, each mapped with a midpoint line, point of control, and internal volume profile. Triangle signals fire on breakouts or retests with state-based filtering against repeat entries. For traders who want zones backed by real participation.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Peak Trading Activity Graphs
indicators.description: Aggregates market history into graphs of median volume and volatility by month, day of month, day of week, or hour of day. Up to four graphs at once across sixteen configurations. A Median Delta mode rescales readings so the busiest and quietest periods stand out instantly. Session planning made empirical for timing, sizing, and market rotation.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Pennant
indicators.description: Detects complete pennants objectively: a pole at least 4 ATRs tall with one-sided momentum, then a 4-15 bar coil that converges by 25%, stays within a tilt tolerance and gives back under half the pole. Breakouts confirm on a close through the fitted boundary with a 1.25x volume expansion by default, drawing the pole, boundaries, a measured-move target and six alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Percentile Nearest Rank Using Arrays
indicators.description: A rolling percentile engine using the nearest-rank method: sort the last N values and read the level below which a chosen percentage of them sit. One Percentage input turns the same engine into a rolling median, quartile bands, or the rolling extremes behind classic channel tools. A statistical building block for quantitatively minded traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Periodic Activity Tracker
indicators.description: Tracks cumulative buy and sell volume inside each hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly period, drawing gradient buy/sell lines, per-period volume bars, and the delta between the two sides. Delimiters and tags keep four consecutive periods readable at a glance. A participation gauge for traders who want to know which side is on the attack.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Periodic Linear Regressions
indicators.description: Fits a linear regression to each anchor period and resets when the next begins: VWAP-style anchoring applied to best-fit lines, drawn as a static line or a rolling series, with RMSE-scaled extremities framing support and resistance. Bicolor and gradient modes flag slope direction instantly. For traders who want trend and channel structure that resets on schedule.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Piercing Line
indicators.description: Detects the piercing line, a two-candle bullish reversal where a long bearish candle meets a weak open and a close reclaiming over half its real body. Configurable open rules, a 50-bar SMA downtrend filter, and optional location and volume checks grade each print, while dashed trigger and stop levels plus four alerts track follow-through, trigger breaks, and invalidation.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Pivot Based Trailing Maxima & Minima
indicators.description: Plots trailing maximums and minimums that reset at confirmed pivot highs and lows, plus their average: a stepped map of past and present support and resistance. Higher highs or lower lows in the trails give an immediate trend read, and a backpaint toggle aligns outputs with the price action that formed them for historical study.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Pivot High/Low Analysis & Forecast
indicators.description: Marks confirmed pivot highs and lows and quantifies them: percent change between consecutive pivots, bar distance between same-type pivots, and trailing means of both on a chart dashboard. Dashed vertical lines then project when the next pivot is statistically due. A descriptive study for traders who plan around swing cadence.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Pivot Point Profile
indicators.description: Pivot Point Profile aggregates historical pivot highs and lows into a horizontal profile, sizing each row by how many swings printed at that price. Concentrated Areas flag the busiest rows and mark their average, exposing the reversal zones price keeps returning to. Built for traders who want support and resistance ranked by evidence rather than drawn by eye.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Pivot Points
indicators.description: Projects the classic floor-trader ladder (a central pivot with up to three support and resistance rungs) from the prior day, week or month, with an Auto anchor that follows the chart timeframe. Keeps five periods of history by default, labels every level with its price, and fires alerts on each rung cross plus the first test of PP, R1 and S1 each period.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Pivot Points Standard
indicators.description: Calculates a central pivot level from the prior period's high, low, and close, and plots the derived support and resistance levels above and below it. A type selector chooses the formula set, Traditional by default, with Fibonacci, Camarilla, and Woodie options, and the pivot timeframe is chosen automatically from the chart resolution. This is the standard pivot points implementation with no proprietary additions.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Pivot Strength
indicators.description: Confirms pivot highs and lows by the bar-count rule (by default a high must exceed 10 bars to its left and stay unexceeded for 10 bars to its right) and prints the price at each confirmed pivot. Dotted traces expose the confirmation delay, hollow markers track provisional candidates, and a dashboard reports pivot counts, average bars per pivot, and candidate progress.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: POC Sweep Reclaim
indicators.description: POC Sweep Reclaim computes each candle's Point of Control from lower-timeframe volume, then hunts a two-step pattern around it: a wick that rejects the level, followed by the next candle closing decisively beyond it. BSR and SSR signals separate bullish from bearish reclaims, giving intraday traders a structured way to trade liquidity traps.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Pocket Pivot
indicators.description: Flags pocket pivots: up closes whose volume beats the largest down-day volume of the prior 10 sessions, in constructive context (close above the 50-bar average with the low near the 10- or 50-bar SMA). Labels report the volume multiple and supporting average, a dashed line tracks the pivot day low stop, and alerts cover signals, continuations, the raw volume rule, and stop breaches.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Point & Figure
indicators.description: Renders a time-compressed Point & Figure chart beside the last bar: X and O columns built from highs and lows with an ATR(14) box size and 3-box reversals by default. Double and triple top or bottom breakouts are highlighted and marked on the price bars, 45-degree trendlines flip as columns pierce them, and vertical and horizontal counts project price objectives.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Point & Figure Cause Counting
indicators.description: Automates the Wyckoff horizontal count on an internally built point & figure grid: ATR-sized boxes with a 3-box reversal by default, and congestions of at least five columns counted once a breakout resolves them. Posts conservative-to-aggressive objective zones, checks stepping-stone agreement against the campaign base, and previews the developing count before entry.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Polarized Fractal Efficiency
indicators.description: Scores how efficiently price traveled across a 10-bar window, smoothed by a 5-period EMA and signed by the net direction: readings near +100 or -100 mark one-way trends, values hovering near zero mark chop. Dashed trending levels at +/-50 anchor regime and decay events, with six alerts covering zero crosses, regime starts and efficiency decay on both sides.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Polynomial Regression Band
indicators.description: Fits a degree-2 polynomial to the last 100 closes by least squares and wraps the curve in bands 2 residual standard deviations wide. A causal end-point line colored by slope never redraws and drives every alert, while an honestly repainting fitted curve shows the current window's full channel. Eight alerts cover band crosses, re-entries, slope turns, and with-trend pullbacks.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Polynomial Regression Extrapolation
indicators.description: Polynomial Regression Extrapolation fits a polynomial of any chosen degree to recent price and projects the fitted curve forward. Degree 1 recovers the straight-line trend, higher degrees bend around accelerating moves, and a Lock Fit option freezes the model so the forecast stays put. A clean statistical lens for trend and turning-point analysis.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Positive Volume Index
indicators.description: The Positive Volume Index compounds a cumulative line by each bar's percentage price change only on sessions where volume rises above the prior bar, holding flat otherwise from a seed of 1000. A 255-period signal EMA anchors the classic regime read (bullish above the average, bearish below) with regime coloring, a gradient fill, and alerts on crosses and slope turns.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Potential Reversal Zone
indicators.description: Projects harmonic Potential Reversal Zones from the last four confirmed swings using 10-bar pivots, fitting Gartley, Bat, Butterfly, or Crab ratios automatically and clustering D from XA, a BC projection, and AB=CD into a scored zone. Measurement levels, 0.382/0.618 AD targets, and an invalidation reference draw with each zone, and eight alerts track entry, rejection, and failure.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Power Hour Breakout Signals
indicators.description: Power Hour Breakout Signals frames the final hour of the U.S. session (3:00 to 4:00 p.m. New York time by default) as a tradable range. It plots the range boundaries, prints bullish and bearish breakout signals, and projects targets through percentage extensions and Fibonacci levels, giving intraday traders structure around the day's busiest hour.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Power Hour Trendlines
indicators.description: Power Hour Trendlines runs a linear regression through the closing prices of the session's final hour (3:00 to 4:00 p.m. New York time by default) across a chosen number of days. Upper and lower lines fitted to the deviations frame direction, volatility, and dynamic support and resistance drawn only from the market's most active data.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: PPO
indicators.description: The PPO measures the spread between a 12- and 26-period EMA as a percentage of the slow average, making momentum readings comparable across symbols, timeframes, and long histories. A 9-period signal line, a histogram whose columns fade as the spread narrows, and a zero-line gradient complete the pane, with six alerts covering signal crosses, zero crosses, and histogram turns.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Precision Market Entropy Heatmap
indicators.description: Precision Market Entropy Heatmap paints volume distribution across every price level of each anchored session, computed from intrabar data for resolution the chart timeframe cannot show. Bright cells expose high-volume nodes and institutional interest, dark cells reveal liquidity voids, and a developing POC polyline tracks value migration live.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Predictive Channels
indicators.description: Predictive Channels estimates the underlying linear trend in real time and wraps it in two support levels, two resistance levels, and an average line. Green and red shading shows instantly whether price runs above or below the estimate, and when price strays too far, a fresh channel is drawn automatically. A fast trend read for discretionary traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Predictive Monte Carlo Engine
indicators.description: Predictive Monte Carlo Engine simulates up to 200 future price paths using geometric Brownian motion, a simple random walk, or bootstrapped historical returns, optionally filtered to bars matching the current trend or momentum regime. Percentile-based projection zones and a next-candle dashboard turn raw uncertainty into levels traders can plan around.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Predictive Ranges
indicators.description: Predictive Ranges forecasts the market's next trading range in real time, plotting non-repainting support and resistance levels around a central tendency line whose slope doubles as a trend gauge. Once price escapes a range, fresh levels print immediately. A LuxAlgo favorite that began as a premium feature and is now open source.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Premier Stochastic
indicators.description: Compresses a double-smoothed 8-bar stochastic through an exponential normalization onto a -1 to +1 scale, steepening movement through the middle of the range and flattening it near the extremes. Crossings out of the ±0.2 neutral band flag fresh directional shifts, exits from the ±0.9 stretched zones flag fading momentum, and all four threshold events carry alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Pretty Good Oscillator
indicators.description: Expresses the close's distance from its 89-period simple moving average in units of smoothed true range, so stretch readings stay comparable across instruments and volatility regimes. Dashed thresholds at +3 and -3 frame the breakout reads of Johnson's original long-term system, with alerts on both threshold breaks and zero-line crosses in either direction.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Previous Highs & Lows
indicators.description: Previous Highs & Lows plots the high and low of each completed period (hourly through yearly) as numbered levels on the chart, with optional zones built from the percentile ranks of those extremes. Position filtering keeps only the levels that still matter relative to price, giving traders an instant map of the references markets test most often.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Price Oscillator
indicators.description: The Price Oscillator takes the difference between a fast and a slow moving average, with a mode input to express it as a percentage of the slow average (PPO, the default) or as an absolute difference (APO). It uses the classic 12/26 lengths and oscillates around a zero line marking the averages' crossovers. This is an unembellished implementation of the standard formula.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Price Simplification
indicators.description: Price Simplification redraws price as a handful of straight segments using the Ramer-Douglas-Peucker algorithm, keeping only the pivots that matter at an ATR-scaled tolerance. The result is market structure without the noise (dominant slope, true swing points, clean geometry) plus an optional dashed extension projecting the last segment's momentum.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Price Volume Trend
indicators.description: Computes a cumulative running total that adds each bar's volume multiplied by its percentage price change, so volume contributes in proportion to the size and direction of the move. The line is cumulative by construction, and an optional signal moving average can be plotted alongside it. This is the classic Price Volume Trend in its standard, unmodified form.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Price Zone Oscillator
indicators.description: Implements Khalil and Steckler's price-persistence gauge: a 14-period EMA of sign-flipped closes divided by an EMA of raw closes, plotted as a percentage swinging around zero. The authors' full zone map ships as defaults (+/-60 extremes, +/-40 trend thresholds and a +15 to -5 neutral band) with eight alerts spanning zero, threshold and zone events.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Probabilistic Breakout Forecaster
indicators.description: Probabilistic Breakout Forecaster quantifies the odds that price escapes its recent range before a chosen number of bars elapses, using a log-normal random walk model over current volatility. Twin probability curves track the bullish and bearish sides while a dashboard adds squeeze intensity, helping breakout traders separate coiled markets from dead ones.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Probability Grid
indicators.description: The Probability Grid maps where the next reversal is statistically likely to land, projecting a 10x10 grid of percentile cells built from your chart's own swing history. Each cell states the odds of a reversal beyond or within it, shown as an on-chart grid or a compact dashboard. For traders who want reversal timing framed as measured probabilities rather than hunches.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Profile Shape Taxonomy
indicators.description: Builds a session profile (volume- or time-weighted, 25 rows over a daily anchor by default) and classifies its silhouette live as a D, P, b or double-distribution day, holding the letter tentative until 75% of a typical session has passed. Completed profiles stay stamped on the chart, the latest rejected thin zone extends right, and ten alerts cover firm shapes, mutations, session closes and revisits.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Projection Bands
indicators.description: Draws Mel Widner's complete projection suite: bands built by sliding a 14-bar window's highs and lows to the latest bar along their fitted slopes, drawn on the price chart, a 0-100 projection oscillator with a 3-period signal line and 80/20 extremes in the pane, plus optional divergences and a bandwidth gauge. Ten alerts cover band touches, extreme entries, signal crosses, divergences and bandwidth shifts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Protected Swings
indicators.description: Protected Swings labels the swing highs and lows a trend should defend. A level earns its PSH or PSL tag only after liquidity is swept and a candle body closes through the run that built the extreme, confirming a change in state of delivery. Confirmation lines hand structure traders objective invalidation for reversals, continuations, and trailing stops.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Proximal Range Filter
indicators.description: The Proximal Range Filter plots a trend line that moves only when price beats a volatility-scaled threshold, using L1 soft-thresholding to hold flat through noise and step with genuine moves. Line and fill flip green or red with the confirmed regime, and switch dots mark each flip at its breakout level. For trend traders who want fewer, cleaner state changes than a moving average delivers.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: PRZ Execution
indicators.description: Manages the test of a harmonic potential reversal zone from arrival to outcome: auto-projects a 0.786-0.886 completion window from the latest X-A-B-C swings or takes manual levels, grades the terminal price bar, confirms entries, and resolves each episode as a Type I reversal, Type II retest, invalidation or expiry. A status table tracks state and stop distance, with nine alerts along the way.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Psychological Line
indicators.description: The Psychological Line counts the bars that closed higher over a 12-bar window and plots the count as a percentage, coloring the line and its gradient fill by which side of the 50% balance line it holds. Dashed 75/25 overbought and oversold levels, an optional smoothed overlay, and six alerts on threshold and balance-line events serve traders who read persistence rather than magnitude.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Pure Price Action ICT Tools
indicators.description: Pure Price Action ICT Tools bundles an ICT workflow into one indicator: real-time market structure, order and breaker blocks, buyside and sellside liquidity, liquidity voids, and ranked swing points, all detected from price patterns alone, with no length inputs to tune. A one-screen toolkit for traders who want their structure mapping objective and hands-free.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Pure Price Action Liquidity Sweeps
indicators.description: Pure Price Action Liquidity Sweeps flags the moment price wicks through a swing level and snaps back: a sweep of resting stops. Swing points are detected purely from price patterns and graded short, intermediate, or long-term, so every sweep is weighted by the significance of the level it raided. No numeric settings to tune, just structure.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Pure Price Action Order & Breaker Blocks
indicators.description: Pure Price Action Order & Breaker Blocks finds zones of concentrated buying or selling and keeps tracking them as they fail and flip into breaker blocks, with swing detection read purely from price patterns, no length inputs. Historical polarity labels replay past setups, and zones can be drawn from candle bodies or full ranges. Objective structure levels for price action traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Pure Price Action Structures
indicators.description: Pure Price Action Structures labels market structure in real time: swing highs and lows ranked short, intermediate, and long-term, with MSS/CHoCH shift labels and BOS continuation breaks, derived entirely from price patterns with zero numeric inputs. The same chart yields the same structure for every trader, on any timeframe.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Put/call Ratio
indicators.description: Put/call Ratio charts a Cboe put/call volume series (equity-only by default) smooths it with a 10-period SMA, and ranks the smoothed line against its own 252-bar distribution. Percentile bands at the 90th and 10th mark fear and complacency extremes with background highlights, a dashboard, and alerts on every extreme entry and exit, built for contrarian sentiment reads.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: PVO
indicators.description: Plots the percentage volume oscillator: a fast 12-period and slow 26-period EMA run on volume, their spread scaled by the slow line into a percentage, plus a signal EMA of 9 and a histogram of their gap. Zero crosses separate expanding from contracting participation, signal crosses time volume-momentum turns, and all four crossings carry alerts, a direction-blind participation gauge to read beside price.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: QQE Weighted Oscillator
indicators.description: The QQE Weighted Oscillator sharpens the classic Quantitative Qualitative Estimation: a weighting stage makes the smoothed RSI work harder to cross its own trailing stop, filtering casual crossovers into smoother, more cyclic signals. Overbought and oversold reads, divergences, and factor-scaled trailing stops for momentum traders who want fewer false flips.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Qstick
indicators.description: Qstick averages each bar's close-minus-open body over 8 bars, quantifying whether recent candles are net bullish or bearish, with a 9-period EMA signal line for a faster trigger. A four-state color scheme separates growing from fading pressure on each side of zero, a gradient fill anchors readings to the zero line, and alerts cover both zero-line and signal-line crosses.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Quarterly Theory
indicators.description: Quarterly Theory divides the chart into Q1-Q4 cycles (daily by default, available from the yearly grid down to 90-minute quarters) labeling each with its expected AMDX phase, plotting the cycle's true open and Q1 range, and reading premium or discount against the true open. A cross-degree dashboard, optional manipulation-signature marks, and nine alerts track the framework live.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: R-squared Trend Fit
indicators.description: Regresses price on time across a 20-bar window and plots R-squared between 0 and 1, gated by a critical value derived from the significance test at 95% confidence: the fit must beat what random data would produce before a trend is declared. Slope supplies direction, a dashboard reports fit, threshold and regime, and five alerts cover gate flips, qualified trends and maturity warnings.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rahul Mohindar Oscillator
indicators.description: A complete construction of the RMO system: ten chained 2-period SMAs feed a range-normalized displacement, smoothed by 30-period EMAs into SwingTrd 2 and 3 while an 81-period EMA forms the RMO bias line. Triangles mark SwingTrd 2/3 crosses made while the RMO holds the matching side of zero, with optional price-chart arrows and four alerts covering signals and regime flips.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rainbow Adaptive RSI
indicators.description: The Rainbow Adaptive RSI runs an RSI on an adaptive moving average input, damping retracements without piling on lag, and unlike a classic RSI it does not collapse toward 50 at higher lengths. A gradient-colored oscillator with a smoothed trigger line and optional cross markers, for momentum traders who want steadier signals through pullbacks.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rainbow MA Stack
indicators.description: Rainbow MA Stack draws up to ten moving averages as one gradient-colored band, defaulting to Widner's recursive construction where each line re-smooths the previous with a 2-period average. A dashboard tracks full bullish or bearish alignment, band width percentile-ranked over 200 bars with 10%/90% compression and expansion extremes, and price's place in the band, with seven stack alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rally Base Drop Signals
indicators.description: Rally Base Drop Signals colors price action in supply-and-demand grammar (Rally runs of bullish candles, Drop runs of bearish candles, transitional Base bars) and flags RBD and DBR reversals plus RBR and DBD continuations as they confirm. A repaint-free Color on Detection mode keeps live charts honest. Built for SND and price action traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rally Base Drop SND Pivots
indicators.description: Rally Base Drop SND Pivots detects pivots to a stricter standard than a fractal: one side of the turn must be all Rally candles, the other all Drop candles, with the Base candle's high or low setting the level. The result is a quieter map of supply and demand reference levels, for SND traders who want pivots that meet a structural bar before charting them.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Random Walk Index
indicators.description: Plots the two Random Walk Index lines, RWI High and RWI Low, scanning every lookback from 8 to 64 bars and keeping each line's maximum, so displacement is judged against an ATR-scaled random walk at its least-random horizon. A dashed threshold at 1 anchors the regime calls, optional exhaustion checks flag fading trends, and seven alerts cover confirmations, crossovers and exhaustion.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Range Average Retest Model
