indicators.description: The Range Average Retest Model draws swing areas between pivots and prints a setup when price recrosses each area's average, complete with take-profit and stop-loss zones scaled from 200-bar volatility. Filters for bias, spacing, and distance manage up to 165 areas at once. A visual laboratory for traders who study retest-style entries.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Range Breakout Signals (Intrabar)
indicators.description: Classifies every candle as trending or ranging from its intrabar price action, hiding the bodies of ranging candles and keeping only their high/low extremities on the chart. Signals fire when price crosses an extremity, with Trend Following and Reversal modes. For traders who want breakout entries filtered by intrabar behavior.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Range Detector
indicators.description: Automatically detects trading ranges and draws their extremities and midline in real time. Extremity colors tell the story at a glance (blue while unbroken, green after an upside break, red after a downside break) and past levels extend forward as support and resistance. A hands-off way to find and trade range-bound markets.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Range Intelligence Suite
indicators.description: Detects ATR-based consolidation zones and arms each range with a delta-coded volume profile, liquidity-sweep labels, and a live dashboard scoring breakout readiness. Net Delta coloring reveals whether a range is accumulating or distributing before it resolves. For breakout and range traders who want direction clues, not just boxes.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Range Sentiment Profile
indicators.description: Splits the recent price range into equidistant rows and measures whether net price variation in each leaned bullish or bearish, volume-profile style. Blue bins flag buyer-dominated areas and orange bins seller-dominated ones, with extended maxima lines and an optional intrabar mode for finer sentiment readings across the range.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rare Candlestick Formations
indicators.description: Rare Candlestick Formations screens for the long tail of the candlestick catalog (advance block, three stars in the south, concealing baby swallow, stick sandwich, ladder top and bottom, and ten more) enforcing each strict definition with adaptive body, shadow, and price-match thresholds plus a 10-bar trend-context filter. Labels, per-formation alerts, and a count dashboard watch the whole catalog.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rate of Change
indicators.description: Rate of Change measures the percentage change between the current price and the price a fixed number of bars ago, plotted as an oscillator around a zero line. The default length is 9, with a mode input to switch from ROC percent (default) to Momentum, which plots the raw price difference instead. This is the standard raw implementation of the indicator.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Re-accumulation
indicators.description: Tracks pauses in established uptrends as candidate re-accumulation: a stall high after a 2-ATR advance opens a range, absorption evidence accumulates across higher lows, recovered dips, springs and rally-versus-reaction volume, and the label confirms only when a breakout holds 3 closes above the range on expanding participation. A decisive loss of support invalidates the read instead.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Re-accumulation vs Re-distribution Diagnosis
indicators.description: Opens a diagnosis whenever a compressed range forms after a 3-ATR trend leg, then weighs entry character, volume asymmetry, edge tests, shakeouts, upthrusts and change of character into a live up-resolution score. The range box shades with the running read, a dashboard itemizes every evidence class, and thirteen alerts run from range detection to the held break that settles the verdict.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Re-distribution
indicators.description: Follows pauses inside established downtrends as candidate re-distribution, filing weak-rally evidence (lower highs, stalled rallies at resistance, upthrusts and contracting up-move volume) on a live dashboard. Confirmation requires a breakdown holding 3 closes below the range low; sustained acceptance above the range high invalidates the thesis as accumulation. Six alerts track the sequence.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Reclaimed Order Block
indicators.description: Builds order blocks from displacement moves, then flags reclaims: zones defended again after a prior respect, or recovered after price closed through them without full acceptance. Confirmation demands a rejection wick or displacement away within 10 bars by default, a swing-structure filter blocks counter-trend signals, and zones retire after 3 uses or decisive acceptance. Six alerts included.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rectangle
indicators.description: Rectangle detects consolidations bounded by parallel horizontal levels, requiring at least two confirmed swing touches per boundary within an ATR-scaled tolerance. It draws the box with its proven touches, projects the measure-rule target on a decisive breakout close with a volume note, flags failed breaks, and marks partial rises and declines: the interior leans toward one side giving way.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Recursive Least Squares Forecast
indicators.description: An adaptive linear regression that re-estimates its slope and intercept on every bar, plotting an equilibrium RLS Mean, volatility-adjusted bands, and a forward Ghost Line projection wrapped in standard-deviation forecast bands. Rules-based mean reversion signals included. For trend followers and mean reversion traders wanting low lag.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Reflex/Trendflex
indicators.description: Plots Ehlers' Reflex and Trendflex from a SuperSmoother-filtered source over a 20-bar window: Reflex averages deviations from a straight-line ramp to isolate cycle swings, Trendflex from the current filter level to keep the trend read. Both self-normalize so 2 marks a typical extreme, with optional divergence drawings and eight alerts covering zero crosses, trend-aligned signals and divergences.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rejection Block
indicators.description: Rejection Block draws the wick spans of confirmed swing highs and lows as tradable zones: bearish from body top to high, bullish from body bottom to low. Defaults require a 10-bar swing and a wick taking at least 50% of the candle's range and 0.5 ATR(14). Zones arm once price leaves, flag their first retest, and invalidate on a body close beyond the extreme, with alerts for every event.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Relative Crypto Dominance Polar Chart
indicators.description: Compares the dominance of up to ten cryptocurrencies on one polar area chart, mapping volatility to each slice's radius and traded dollar volume to its arc. Larger areas mean greater dominance, with hourly-to-yearly periods, automatic period selection, sorting, and deep styling control. A one-glance market share read for crypto traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Relative Momentum Index
indicators.description: The Relative Momentum Index measures up and down changes against the close 5 bars back instead of bar to bar, then applies 14-period Wilder smoothing and scales to 0-100. The line colors bullish above its 50 midline with a gradient fill, framed by dashed 80/20 bands, with alerts on zone entries, exits and midline crosses. For traders who want RSI grammar with smoother, more decisive swings.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Relative Performance Areas
indicators.description: Shades every session green or red depending on whether the charted asset beat or lagged a chosen benchmark, with SPX as the default comparison. Three display modes (net, rescaled, and standardized returns) set how the benchmark is transformed before comparison, while a dashboard tallies outperformance streaks. Relative strength made visible session by session.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Relative Strength Index
indicators.description: The Relative Strength Index measures the speed and magnitude of recent price changes by comparing average gains to average losses over a lookback window, plotting a bounded oscillator between 0 and 100. Defaults are a length of 14 on a selectable source, with overbought and oversold levels at 70 and 30. This is the standard raw implementation of Wilder's RSI with the classic settings.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Relative Strength Scatter Plot
indicators.description: Plots user-selected symbols on a four-quadrant scatter of relative strength ratio versus momentum against a benchmark, in the spirit of relative rotation analysis. Configurable trails show each symbol rotating through leading, weakening, improving, and lagging phases. Built for rotation-minded traders comparing several markets at once.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Relative Vigor Index
indicators.description: The Relative Vigor Index compares where price closes relative to its open, smoothing close-minus-open against high-minus-low over a lookback window to gauge the conviction behind recent bars. It plots the RVI line with a default length of 10 and its 4-period symmetrically weighted signal line. The build is the standard raw version of the indicator.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Relative Volatility Index
indicators.description: The Relative Volatility Index applies RSI-style smoothing to standard deviation instead of price change, splitting volatility into up-day and down-day components to show the direction volatility is leaning on a 0 to 100 scale. It defaults to a 10-period standard deviation with 14-period smoothing. This is a straight implementation of the standard formula.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Renko Boxes
indicators.description: Overlays volatility-adaptive Renko bricks directly on the candlestick chart, sizing each brick from the Average True Range so the structure adjusts to market conditions. Green and red boxes with dotted average lines track the active trend, and reversal dots mark confirmed flips. Renko noise filtering without giving up time-based candles.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Responsive vs Initiative Activity
indicators.description: Classifies every bar against the prior session's value area into initiative or responsive buying and selling, colors bars by quadrant, and extends the prior VAH, VAL and POC across the session. Acceptance beyond value requires 5 bars and 20% of session volume by default, failed probes are flagged, and a dashboard totals each class's share, with eight alerts on the key auction events.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Retest & Break Setup
indicators.description: Detects the full break, retest, and continuation sequence: a pivot level breaks, price returns to test it a required number of times, then closes beyond the retest extreme to complete the setup. A dashboard tracks setup counts, completions, and post-breakout statistics. For traders who want breakout continuation with confirmation built in.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Reversal Candlestick Structure
indicators.description: Detects sixteen classic candlestick patterns and filters them through a stochastic-based reversal algorithm, so patterns are highlighted only when trend conditions favor a turn. Candle coloring cues developing reversals, and a dashboard reports the share of patterns that coincided with them. A pattern scanner with context built in.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Reversal Probability Rows
indicators.description: Divides the recent price range into horizontal rows and assigns each a reversal probability drawn from the distribution of historical pivot highs and lows. Red boxes quantify resistance overhead, green boxes support below, with opacity scaled to pivot density. A statistical alternative to hand-drawn support and resistance levels.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Reversal Probability Zone & Levels
indicators.description: Statistical zones that estimate where and when the next reversal is likely, projected from the last detected swing along both price and time axes. Up to four configurable percentile levels rank past reversals, with bullish and bearish swings sampled separately. Built for traders who want reversal odds grounded in history rather than guesswork.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Reversal Signals
indicators.description: A counter-trend engine that counts candle closes through two phases (a 9-count Momentum Phase and a 13-count Trend Exhaustion Phase) to flag where a move may be running out of fuel. Completed counts print long and short setups with support, resistance, and risk levels, giving reversal traders a rules-based framework for timing turns.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rising & Falling Window Signals
indicators.description: Detects Rising and Falling Windows (candlestick gaps where the wicks of consecutive candles never overlap) and turns each into a managed support and resistance zone. ATR-based width filters, zone-lifetime controls, and three signal types (Regular, Engulfing, Wick) keep the chart focused on the gaps that still matter.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rising/falling Three Methods
indicators.description: Detects rising and falling three methods patterns with 2 to 5 middle candles contained inside the first candle's range, long first and resolution bodies at 1.2x a 14-bar average, and a 50-bar SMA trend filter by default. Draws the containment zone, labels completions R3M or F3M, and extends an invalidation level from the far end of the range, with three completion alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Risk Management Tool
indicators.description: An on-chart position manager that sizes trades from account capital and per-trade risk, then tracks P&L against stop-loss and take-profit levels defined by fixed price, percentage, ATR, or rolling range. Entries can fire automatically when price crosses an external indicator: practical discipline for longs and shorts alike.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: RMA
indicators.description: RMA plots Wilder's recursive smoother with a 14-bar default on the close, slope trend coloring and a gradient fill against price. Optional overlays add a second 50-bar RMA for a crossover pair, plus same-length EMA and SMA lines and the exact-alpha 2N-1 EMA for comparison, while a dashboard reports the smoothing factor, EMA equivalence, slope state and which side of the line price holds.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: ROC-of-ROC
indicators.description: ROC-of-ROC plots the second derivative of price: a 9-bar percent rate of change differenced again over 9 bars, with SMA smoothing applied to the output (3 bars by default). The acceleration line is colored by a four-state read - advance or decline, accelerating or decelerating - above a velocity context line, and alerts flag zero crosses and the bar a move first starts decelerating.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rogers-Satchell Estimator
indicators.description: The Rogers-Satchell Estimator averages the drift-independent per-bar variance ln(H/C)ln(H/O) + ln(L/C)ln(L/O) over a 20-bar window and annualizes it at 252 bars per year. A close-to-close comparison line on the same settings isolates how much measured volatility is drift, percentile thresholds at 80/20 drive expansion and compression alerts, and a dashboard reports the spread and rank.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rolling Liquidity Clusters Channel
indicators.description: A three-line channel that locates the most-respected prices in a rolling window: levels wicks keep rejecting while candle bodies never close through. Red resistance, green support, and an orange equilibrium line map where stop runs and failed breakouts concentrate, serving range traders and breakout traders alike.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rolling Segment
indicators.description: A volatility-adjusted trend line drawn as straight segments that hold their slope until the market state changes. Slow mode keeps it smooth in quiet conditions, Fast mode kicks in when momentum expands, and ATR-based thresholds print triangle markers at trend reversals: a clean, readable framework for trend followers.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rolling Trendline
indicators.description: A self-maintaining trendline that projects its regression slope forward bar by bar and re-anchors only when price breaks statistically from the path. ATR zones wrap the line into dynamic support and resistance, and reset markers expose regime shifts: automated structure for trend, pullback, and breakout traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rolling VWAP Channel
indicators.description: A percentile channel distilled from up to 500 rolling VWAPs, each anchored at a different bar. Where the volume-weighted averages cluster, the channel exposes consolidation zones that often precede breakouts; percentile lines, anchor period, and pool size are all configurable. Suits mean-reversion and breakout traders alike.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Roofing Filter
indicators.description: The Roofing Filter chains Ehlers' two published stages: a two-pole high-pass keyed to 48 bars strips trend and drift, then a 10-bar SuperSmoother removes noise and aliasing. The surviving cycle band plots as a zero-mean line colored by sign with a gradient fill, and alerts fire on zero crosses and slope turns. For traders who want oscillator inputs freed from spectral dilation.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rotation Factor
indicators.description: Rotation Factor keeps Market Profile's day-timeframe auction tally: each completed 30-minute TPO bracket is scored against its predecessor, +1 for a higher high or low and -1 for lower ones, summed across a daily session. The stepline plots against the session's own possible range with strong-rotation levels at 50%, bracket columns, an effort-versus-result dashboard and six alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Round Numbers
indicators.description: Round Numbers draws the psychological price grid automatically: big figures sized to the instrument, dashed half levels and dotted quarter levels beneath them, managed by a 40-line budget that thins the finest tiers first. Decade figures draw thicker, labels print each figure's price, and alerts fire on approaches within 10% of the step, tests of the figure zone, and closes through a figure.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: RSI BAMM
indicators.description: Runs Scott Carney's staged RSI BAMM sequence on a 14-period RSI: an initial push beyond the 70/30 extremes, a pullback that must hold the 50 level, then a second price extreme on weaker momentum that freezes a 0.886-1.13 completion zone on price. Reversal markers print when RSI rolls over inside the zone, with eight alerts running from trigger to exit management.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: RSI Bands
indicators.description: RSI Bands solves Wilder's RSI backward and plots the prices at which RSI would print 70, 30 and 50 on the current bar - an overbought band, an oversold band and a midline drawn in the price pane. The bands use a 14-bar length on the close and exact algebra rather than estimates, gradient fills span midline to band, and alerts cover band tags, releases and midline crosses.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: RSI Candlestick Oscillator
indicators.description: Renders RSI as full OHLC candlesticks rather than a single line, scaling each bar's open, high, low, and close into the oscillator pane. Wick tests and full-bodied breaks of RSI levels become visible at a glance, and divergences detected from candle extremes are drawn on both the oscillator and the price chart.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: RSI Divergence: Out-of-Sample Optimizer
indicators.description: A research dashboard that backtests price-RSI divergence trading across dozens of RSI periods, selects the best performer in-sample, then validates it on out-of-sample and forward data. A sensitivity heatmap reveals whether the winning period sits in a robust cluster or stands alone as a curve-fit outlier.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: RSI Failure Swing
indicators.description: Runs Wilder's failure swing pattern as a state machine on a 14-period RSI, drawing each setup's swing legs, a dashed fail point line, and HL/LH labels, then marking Bull FS or Bear FS when the fail point breaks. Detection reacts only to confirmed 3-bar swings so nothing repaints, with setup and completion alerts on both sides.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: RSI Multi Length
indicators.description: Aggregates RSIs of every length between your chosen bounds into a single composite oscillator, then shows what percentage of them are overbought or oversold on each bar. Green and red breadth areas plus a live dashboard reveal momentum agreement across horizons at a glance: context no single-length RSI can offer.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: RSI of Other Sources
indicators.description: Points Wilder's 14-period RSI formula at a series of your choice: On-Balance Volume by default, or Volume, VWAP Distance, Momentum, Rate of Change, another symbol, or any custom plot. The derived line is drawn beside a same-length price RSI for instant comparison, with 70/30 thresholds, optional input smoothing, and six crossing alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: RSI Prediction by Range Segmentation
indicators.description: Forecasts the likely path of RSI by segmenting the 0-100 scale into momentum buckets and averaging what historically followed similar starting zones. A forward polyline projects the expected trajectory with bullish or bearish coloring, giving momentum traders a data-driven read on continuation versus exhaustion.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: RSI Regime Filter
indicators.description: The RSI Regime Filter validates classic RSI signals against a live classification of market conditions, plotting divergences and overbought/oversold cues only when the environment favors them. Four regime methods (RSI, EMA trend, ADX, or a composite vote), volume bubbles at extremes, and a context dashboard - for oscillator traders tired of fading runaway trends.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: RSI-2
indicators.description: RSI-2 runs Wilder's RSI with a 2-bar lookback and frames the classic mean-reversion playbook around it: 90/10 bands mark stretched two-bar moves, a 200-bar trend filter decides which side is tradable, and a 5-bar exit average tracks the resolving close. Setup triangles print on the price chart, and six alerts cover setups, exits and raw band stretches in both directions.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: RTH vs ETH
indicators.description: Splits intraday charts into regular and extended hours: the overnight session is shaded, the developing ETH high and low are plotted and projected across the day session, and the prior RTH close is carried forward as the gap reference. A dashboard compares average range, volume share, and extreme attribution over a 20-day lookback, with nine session, gap, and level-test alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Rubber Band Liquidity Signals
indicators.description: Rubber Band Liquidity Signals maps a four-stage cycle - trend, consolidation, liquidity sweep, continuation - directly onto your chart. ATR-scaled boxes define each range, sweep lines flag the stop run through its boundary, and a B label with a yellow V confirms the snap back in trend direction. Built for breakout traders who want the traps filtered out first.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Runaway Gap
indicators.description: Flags continuation gaps printing mid-trend: a bar opening entirely beyond the prior bar's range, at least 0.1% of price by default, in the direction of a 50-bar trend already held for 10 bars, on solid but not climactic volume between 1x and 3x average. Each gap zone stays boxed until filled, with a measuring-gap target projection and alerts for prints, retests, fills and target hits.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Scallop
indicators.description: Detects ascending and descending scallops (the rounded J-shaped continuation curves) by fitting a quadratic to each candidate span and demanding an R-squared of 0.8, a 3-25% depth over 15-100 bars, and a turn gradual enough to hold 30% of bars near its extreme. Completed curves draw target and stop levels, with a live developing-curve preview and shrinking-series alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Schaff Trend Cycle
indicators.description: A clean 0-100 Schaff Trend Cycle: a MACD from 23- and 50-period EMAs is passed twice through a 10-bar stochastic with 0.5 recursive smoothing, colored by its side of the 50 midline. Dashed triggers at 75 and 25 frame the reads (a cross up through the lower trigger flags an emerging uptrend), and four alerts cover trigger crosses and extreme entries.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Seasonality Chart
indicators.description: The Seasonality Chart condenses years of daily data into one seasonal curve, averaging each calendar day's price change into a seasonal index running January through December. Cumulative sums, percent-change mode, and a least-squares regression line reveal which stretches of the year leaned bullish or bearish - for daily-timeframe traders and calendar-effect researchers.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Seasonality Widget
indicators.description: The Seasonality Widget buckets market history by hour, weekday, day of month, month, or day of year, then reports the mean, median, max, min, or max-min average of price change, range, or volume per bucket. Distorting years can be filtered out entirely - for traders who want calendar tendencies measured rather than remembered.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Sector Correlation Matrix
indicators.description: The Sector Correlation Matrix tracks rolling Pearson correlation between your charted symbol and any benchmark, classifying the relationship into five states from Strong Positive to Strong Negative. An oscillator pane plus a live dashboard show whether an asset is moving with the market or decoupling - for stock, crypto, and forex traders weighing relative strength and risk.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Seek & Destroy Profile
indicators.description: Classifies the trading day against the seek & destroy template: an early range (midnight to 08:30 ET by default) freezes into reference levels, joined by the prior day's high and low, and every bar of the 08:30-16:00 window is tested for sweeps, acceptance, and displacement. A dashboard tracks the live state, base rates, and a stand-aside read, with six alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Sequencer
indicators.description: The Sequencer counts structured sequences of closes against earlier prices through two phases - Preparation and Lead-Up - to flag potential exhaustion and reversal points, with completion levels marking key prices. Phase lengths, comparison periods, refined steps, suspension, and cancellation are all adjustable - for reversal traders who want the count on their own terms.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Session & Weekly Profiles
indicators.description: Puts the ICT session clock on the chart: shaded Asia, London killzone, New York killzone, and London close windows, a frozen Asian range with Judas sweep labels, and a weekly open reference. Completed days and weeks are labeled with the template they matched (classic bullish or bearish, reversal profiles, or none), with seventeen alerts covering the sequence.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Session Gap Fill
indicators.description: Session Gap Fill marks every opening gap between trading sessions, tracks whether each one fills, and compiles the outcomes into an on-chart dashboard: gap direction share, fill rates, post-fill reversals, and average bars to fill. Overlapping and non-overlapping gaps can be studied separately - for day traders who want the open quantified before they trade it.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Session Levels Predictor
indicators.description: The Session Levels Predictor projects up to three expected highs and three expected lows the moment your defined session opens, derived from percentile statistics of past session extremes, with hit-rate percentages reporting how often each level has been reached. Empirical anchors for targets and stops - for session traders who plan the trade before the move.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Session Streaks
indicators.description: Session Streaks labels every trading session bullish or bearish and counts how many consecutive sessions have shared the same bias, while a dashboard reports the number, median, and mode of historical streak lengths. Gradient-colored session ranges add an instant read of price position - for traders timing continuation and reversal by session rhythm.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Session Sweep & iFVG RR
indicators.description: Session Sweep & iFVG RR automates a complete smart-money setup: it tracks a chosen session's high and low, validates liquidity sweeps that snap back inside the range, confirms entries on a trendline break, and draws a risk-reward box with stops from inverted fair value gaps or ATR - for traders who want the whole sequence handled by one tool.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Session Sweeps
indicators.description: Session Sweeps highlights the moment price runs the high or low of a major trading session and snaps back - the classic liquidity grab - then layers market structure shifts (CHoCH) and fair value gaps on top for confirmation. Sessions, sweep zones, and structure detection are fully configurable - for ICT-style traders hunting stop runs at session extremes.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Session Volume Moving Average
indicators.description: Session Volume Moving Average plots volume as bars anchored to a moving average of price, normalized by the 95th volume percentile so outlier spikes stop flattening the display. Session-aware extras - a cumulative delta gradient, end-of-session volume profiles, and streak boxes - show who controls each session and where activity clusters. For volume readers who think in sessions.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Sessions
indicators.description: Sessions draws up to four fully custom session windows on the chart, each with an optional range highlight, trendline, mean, and session VWAP, plus a dashboard scoring status, trend, volume, and volatility per window. Built for intraday traders who want to isolate exactly how price behaves inside each regional trading period.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Shark
indicators.description: Detects bullish and bearish Shark patterns from confirmed swings: an AB leg extending 1.13-1.618 of XA beyond the X pivot, with the completion band bracketed by the whole 0X leg's 0.886 retracement and 1.13 extension. The reversal zone, measured ratios, invalidation line and staged targets at 0.382 and 0.618 of the BC leg are all drawn, with twelve alerts through the pattern's life.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Short-Term Order Block Rejections
indicators.description: This indicator identifies short-term order blocks initiated by market structure shifts and monitors for price rejection signals within these zones. Traders use this tool to spot potential entry opportunities at structural extremes where momentum shifts have occurred. It incorporates structural filtering and ATR-based range assessments to minimize signals in consolidating or low-volatility conditions, helping users align their entries with broader market structural trends.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Sigmoid Transition Trailing Stop
indicators.description: Sigmoid Transition Trailing Stop is an ATR trailing stop that pulls itself toward price along an S-curve whenever the gap grows too wide, instead of waiting for a new extreme. Line color and opacity show trend direction and whether the adjustment phase is running, giving trend followers tighter protection without abrupt stop jumps.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Signal Forge
indicators.description: Signal Forge merges 11 harmonized technical filters (from SMA, EMA, and MACD crossovers to Supertrend, RSI, and ADX/DI) into one signal engine with strict all-agree or flexible any-trigger logic. On-chart orbs, historical win-rate labels, ATR-based exits, and dual dashboards let traders assemble and audit a confluence system without code.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Signal Moving Average
indicators.description: Signal Moving Average is a purpose-built signal line for moving average cross systems: it tracks price like a normal average in trends but deliberately pulls away during ranges, cutting whipsaw crosses and the transaction costs they generate. A color-coded fill and trend-only line coloring give an instant trend-or-range read.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Significant Breakout Levels (FVG)
indicators.description: Significant Breakout Levels (FVG) plots pivot-based support and resistance, then only signals a break when the candle body clears an ATR-scaled strength test and a fair value gap confirms the direction. Green and red boxes flag validated breaks while stale or failed levels are cleared away, keeping the chart focused on high-conviction setups.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Sine-weighted MA
indicators.description: Plots a moving average whose weights trace half a sine cycle across a 20-bar window, tapering to near zero at both edges for a visibly calmer line. Slope-based trend coloring, a gradient fill against price and an optional 10-bar fast SWMA crossover pair are built in, with a dashboard quoting the window's half-length lag. For traders who value smoothness over early turns.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Single Prints
indicators.description: Builds a TPO distribution for each anchor period (daily sessions of 30-minute brackets by default) and boxes every mid-profile run of rows that traded in exactly one bracket. Completed single-print zones extend right and shrink as price repairs them; dashed boxes track singles forming in the live session. Four alerts cover fresh singles, first retests, defended probes and full repairs.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: SMA Directional Matrix
indicators.description: SMA Directional Matrix compresses an entire stack of simple moving averages into one panel: every period between your chosen Min and Max gets a row showing whether that average is currently rising or falling. Full alignment exposes clean trends, mixed readings expose retracements or ranges. Market posture read in a single glance.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Smart Money Concepts (SMC)
indicators.description: Smart Money Concepts (SMC) automates the complete price-action markup: internal and swing market structure with BOS and CHoCH labels, order blocks, equal highs and lows, fair value gaps, multi-timeframe highs and lows, and premium/discount zones, all drawn in real time. The reference tool for traders who work structure and liquidity.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Smart Money Index
indicators.description: Accumulates the session-anatomy line that subtracts the cash open's first 30 minutes and adds the final hour, with both window lengths and weights adjustable. A 20-period moving average colors the SMI and fires cross alerts, while pivot-based detection draws divergences against price. On daily and higher charts it falls back to overnight-gap versus open-to-close arithmetic, for index traders reading session flow.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: SMI Ergodic
indicators.description: The SMI Ergodic is the ergodic form of the True Strength Index: double EMA-smoothed price change divided by double EMA-smoothed absolute price change, following the platform convention rather than a range-based construction. It defaults to TSI lengths 5 and 20 with an EMA-5 signal line, and includes a display option to show it as an indicator with signal line or as an oscillator of their difference. This is the plain standard implementation of that form.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: SMT Divergences
indicators.description: SMT Divergences compares swing highs and lows on your chart against two user-selected correlated tickers, typically ES and YM, and labels the moments one instrument breaks its swing while the other refuses to follow. A statistics dashboard tracks how often those cracks appear, turning a discretionary read into measurable data.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Speed Resistance Lines
indicators.description: Fans the three Gould rays from a measured swing: the full-speed line drawn solid, the 2/3 speedline dashed and the 1/3 speedline dotted, auto-anchored to the latest completed 25-bar swing or to two hand-set points. Ten alerts track the cascade of closing breaks, intrabar holds and role-reversal retests on rising and falling fans, for trend traders who benchmark pace rather than price.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Spinning Top
indicators.description: Tags candles whose small centered body sits between shadows each longer than the body (the classic indecision bar) under adjustable body, shadow-ratio and centering rules. A 20-bar trend SMA classifies each pattern as printing after an advance, after a decline or in range, and resolution markers flag the close that breaks its extremes, for traders who want indecision graded rather than eyeballed.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Spline Quantile Regression Channel
indicators.description: Spline Quantile Regression Channel fits cubic splines to chosen quantiles of recent price, producing a channel that bends with the trend instead of forcing a straight line. The median spline reads direction, the outer bands mark statistically stretched prices, and a dashed extension projects the fitted curve into future bars.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Spring
indicators.description: Detects Wyckoff springs against ranges the script establishes itself: support needs at least 20 bars of ranging and two tested swing lows before an undercut counts. A reclaim within 5 bars prints a graded Spring or Shakeout label scored on penetration depth, probe volume and reclaim speed, then a quiet-volume test confirms it, with the spring low drawn as the invalidation line for Wyckoff-minded traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Squeeze Index
indicators.description: Squeeze Index distills price compression into a single percentage reading: the tighter the coil, the higher the number. Built from converging exponential envelopes rather than band width, it gives breakout traders a direct way to rank consolidation intensity and prepare for the expansion that tends to follow.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Squeeze Release Direction
indicators.description: Grades the direction of every squeeze fire instead of assuming it: when 20-period Bollinger Bands re-emerge from 1.5x Keltner Channels, five votes (momentum sign, band tilt, close-based breakout side, volume expansion and the daily 50 EMA trend) combine into a Bullish, Bearish or Ambiguous read with a Strong, Moderate or Weak grade, labeled on the chart for breakout traders wary of head fakes.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.description: Stablecoin Dominance charts the supply share of USDT, USDC, BUSD, DAI, and TUSD as color-filled dominance areas, with any coin toggleable in or out of the calculation. Crypto traders use it to watch dollar liquidity rotate between issuers and to overlay those shifts against price for macro context.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Standard Deviation
indicators.description: Standard Deviation computes the sample standard deviation of a selected price source over a lookback window and plots it as a single line, quantifying how far prices deviate from their mean over that period. Defaults are a length of 20 with a configurable source input. This is the plain statistical measure in its raw form, with no bands or smoothing added.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Standard Error Bands
indicators.description: Standard Error Bands fit a linear regression line to price over a lookback window and plot bands offset above and below it by a multiple of the standard error of the regression estimate, so the bands tighten when price tracks its trend closely and widen when it does not. Defaults follow the classic settings: length 21, bands at plus and minus 2 standard errors, with 3-period smoothing applied. The build is a standard implementation of Jon Andersen's original formulation.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Standard-deviation Channel Width
indicators.description: Measures the rail-to-rail width of a least-squares regression channel (100 bars and 2 standard deviations by default), quoted as a percent of the midline or in price units. The reading is compared against its own 100-bar average, with a 0.5x compression threshold flagging coiled trends, a dashboard, an optional on-chart channel, and four alerts on average crosses and compression.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Standardized Cumulative Deltas
indicators.description: Standardized Cumulative Deltas tracks the running open-to-close delta of up to ten tickers at once, standardized so crypto, forex, and equities can share one scale. Density envelopes summarize where the whole basket leans bullish or bearish, making it a sentiment map for basket traders and correlation watchers.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: STARC Bands
indicators.description: Draws Stoller Average Range Channels: a 5-bar simple moving average with bands offset 2 times a 15-bar average true range, plus an optional 3x outer extreme ring. Band tags read as stretch against recent average range rather than breakout invitations, and eight alerts cover tags, single-tag rejections, centerline crosses and outer-band events, for mean-reversion and risk-aware entries.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Statistical Trailing Stop
indicators.description: A trailing stop that sets its distance with statistics instead of guesswork: four levels derived from the log-normal distribution of grouped volatility, from reactive Level 0 to patient Level 3. A built-in dashboard records the outcome of every detected signal, so trend followers can judge which level actually fits the market in front of them.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Stochastic
indicators.description: The Stochastic Oscillator locates the current close within the high-low range of a lookback window, plotting %K alongside a %D moving-average line on a 0 to 100 scale. Defaults are a %K length of 14 with smoothing 3, a %D length of 3, and reference levels at 80 and 20. This is the standard raw implementation of Lane's stochastic with the classic parameter set.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Stochastic Adaptive %D
indicators.description: An oscillator that plots the gap between a pre-smoothed Stochastic %D and an adaptive %D baseline as a 50-centered histogram. The baseline stiffens near the midline and speeds up near the 80/20 extremes, fading whipsaws while catching genuine momentum shifts early. Built for traders who find the classic stochastic too noisy to trust.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Stochastic Pop
indicators.description: Stochastic Pop plots a fast %K (14-period, smoothing 1) with 80/20 thresholds, trading a push above the upper band as a momentum burst rather than an overbought stretch. Optional ADX-contraction, weekly EMA trend and volume screens filter each trigger, with entry/exit markers, a checklist dashboard and pop, drop and exit alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Stochastic RSI
indicators.description: Stochastic RSI applies the stochastic formula to RSI values rather than price, expressing where RSI sits within its own recent range as an oscillator between 0 and 100 with K and D smoothing lines. Defaults are RSI length 14, stochastic length 14, K smoothing 3, and D smoothing 3. This is the standard implementation of the Chande and Kroll indicator with its usual defaults.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Stop Placement vs Liquidity Pools
indicators.description: Stop Placement vs Liquidity Pools maps stop pockets beyond confirmed swings, prior day and week extremes and round numbers as ATR-scaled zones, labels every pierce as a Sweep or Break, and projects safer stop guides beyond the nearest pocket plus a 0.5 ATR buffer. An optional audit checks an intended stop price against every mapped pocket.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Stop-and-reverse
indicators.description: Stop-and-reverse runs a parabolic always-in engine: a trailing level accelerates toward price (start 0.02, step 0.02, maximum 0.2) and each touch closes one leg and opens the opposite one in the same act. A dashboard tracks the flip fill, initial risk and open R-multiple, while a whipsaw monitor flags four or more flips inside a 50-bar window.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Stopping Volume
indicators.description: Stopping Volume flags bars where at least twice baseline volume prints the lowest low of a 20-bar decline yet closes mid-range or higher, then tracks the absorption zone through a 5-bar stall window and a low-volume test. An event-anchored VWAP follows the latest signal, with optional topping-out detection and eight alert conditions.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Strength/weakness Background
indicators.description: Shades the chart background by the balance of volume-spread evidence: stopping volume, shakeouts and successful tests build the strength side, while upthrusts, no-demand rallies and effort without result build weakness. Events decay over a 30-bar window, the verdict flips only past a threshold, structure breaks confirm it, and eight alerts cover flips, confirmations and signs.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Structural Leg Profiler
indicators.description: Detects bullish and bearish structural legs with ATR-based swing logic, then builds a lower-timeframe volume profile inside each move: total volume, net delta, and POC labeled per leg. Untested POCs extend forward as dashed levels and unusual volume prints as bubbles, giving structure traders a participation check on every swing.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Structural SVM Ranker
indicators.description: Scores every break of structure and change of character from 0 to 100 using a linear SVM-inspired model that weighs relative volume, RSI momentum, and ATR-normalized break distance. Instead of treating all structure breaks alike, it shows which ones carry real conviction: a quality filter for charts crowded with BOS and CHoCH labels.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Structure & Trend Dashboard
indicators.description: A multi-timeframe command center that labels BOS and CHoCH, highlights liquidity sweeps, and boxes fair value gaps while a compact table tracks whether higher- and lower-timeframe trends agree. Checkbox rows make alignment readable at a glance: made for traders who only take entries when their timeframes agree.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Structure Invalidation
indicators.description: Tracks the swing level a structural trade thesis depends on and referees its break mechanically: a 10-bar swing rule pins the protected level, a pre-chosen rule (close beyond, by default) declares invalidation, and each event is graded as displaced or reclaimed against a 14-period ATR. A gradient fill shows the room left before the thesis dies, with four alerts on breaks and reclaims.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Structure Volume Profile Setups
indicators.description: Structure Volume Profile Setups identifies market structure shifts using BOS and CHoCH to trigger trading opportunities. The indicator constructs volume profiles over the most recent trend leg, identifying the Point of Control as a primary entry zone. Traders use these retracement setups to target value areas or fixed ATR distances, supported by HTF trend filters and gap avoidance to ensure high quality execution.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: SuperIchi
indicators.description: An Ichimoku rebuilt on Supertrend logic: Tenkan, Kijun, and Senkou Span B come from ATR-based trend detection instead of fixed-window midpoints, resetting their averages whenever a fresh trend begins. The one-glance Ichimoku read survives intact, with fewer whipsaws, for trend traders who want a calmer cloud.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: SuperTrend
indicators.description: SuperTrend plots a trailing stop line above or below price, built from the average true range: the line sits at the median price plus or minus a multiple of ATR and flips sides when price crosses it. Defaults are the classic ATR length of 10 with a multiplier of 3. This build follows the standard SuperTrend formula as originally published.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: SuperTrend AI (Clustering)
indicators.description: A SuperTrend that picks its own factor: the indicator runs the calculation across a whole factor range, measures how each instance performs, and k-means-clusters the results so the live trailing stop uses the strongest group's settings. Signals print a performance metric, and an adaptive average doubles as support and resistance.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Supertrend Channels
indicators.description: A channel reworking of the Supertrend built from trailing maximums and minimums: bands climb through uptrends, fall through downtrends, and their extremities double as support and resistance. A middle line filters out market noise, handing trend traders Donchian-style levels that reset with each trend flip.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: SuperTrend Oscillator
indicators.description: Re-expresses the distance between price and the SuperTrend as a bounded -100 to 100 oscillator with a signal line and MACD-style histogram. Readings near the extremes confirm strong trends, the 50/-50 zone exposes retracements, and validity symbols plus a false-signal percentage grade the SuperTrend's own reliability.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Supertrend Parameter Sensitivity 3D
indicators.description: Evaluates 100 Supertrend length-and-multiplier combinations bar by bar and renders the results as a 3D performance surface on the chart, with win rate, net profit, profit factor, or reward-to-risk on the vertical axis. A stability engine hunts parameter plateaus instead of lucky peaks, and can auto-apply the most robust settings.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: SuperTrend Polyfactor Oscillator
indicators.description: Stacks 20 SuperTrends with stepped factors into a single pane: a mesh of bars whose brightness shows how strongly the set agrees, a median consensus line that tracks market bias, and a standard-deviation area separating trending from ranging conditions. Normalization options keep outputs comparable across timeframes and models.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: SuperTrend Recovery
indicators.description: A SuperTrend that fights back in deep pullbacks: once price moves a set number of ATRs against the active trend, the band enters recovery mode and exponentially tightens toward price instead of waiting. BULL and BEAR flip labels with gradient fills keep the classic read. The drawdown handling is what's new.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Supply and Demand Anchored
indicators.description: Draws volume-based supply and demand zones between two anchor points you place directly on the chart, so the calculation covers exactly the swing, session, or event you care about. Zones extend forward as candidate support and resistance, and both anchors stay draggable for instant recalculation. Built for traders who want zone analysis on their own terms.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Supply and Demand Daily
indicators.description: Builds each day's supply and demand zones automatically from the prior session and plots them as support and resistance on any chart. Zone width tells its own story (wide areas kept price away, thin ones saw constant testing), and the running history doubles as a trend map. A hands-off zone tool made for day traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Supply and Demand Visible Range
indicators.description: Converts the volume traded across your visible chart range into supply and demand zones, recalculating instantly as you scroll or zoom. Intra-bar data sharpens each area, while solid and dashed lines mark plain and volume-weighted averages inside every zone. The original LuxAlgo volume-based zone detector, made for visual analysis.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Supply Demand Profiles
indicators.description: Profiles traded volume across every price in a range you select, framing supply and demand zones alongside a full volume profile and a sentiment profile. Choose raw volume or volume delta as the source and pick from five polarity methods to split activity into buying and selling. A complete range-analysis station for volume-minded traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Support & Resistance Pro Toolkit
indicators.description: A structural analysis toolkit that finds support and resistance through four swing engines (Pivots, Donchian Alternating, CSID, and ZigZag) and draws them as ATR-scaled zones with a breakout confirmation buffer. Filters for retests, sweeps, volume, and duration keep only proven levels, while a live dashboard tracks mitigation and duration stats.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Support & Resistance Zones Strength Classifier
indicators.description: Clusters pivot highs and lows into volatility-scaled support and resistance zones and ranks each by how many times price has respected it. Well-tested zones darken and can display test counts, overlapping zones merge, and broken ones vanish automatically. A self-cleaning structure map for pullback and breakout traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Support and Resistance Levels with Breaks
indicators.description: Plots pivot-based support and resistance levels and tags the breaks that matter, using a volume oscillator to screen out low-volume breaches. Wick-heavy break candles earn their own bull or bear notation, adding a momentum read to each signal. A clean, classic tool for breakout traders tired of chasing noise.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Support and Resistance Signals MTF
indicators.description: Detects swing-based support and resistance zones and stamps the price action around them (breakouts, tests, retests, and rejections) with non-repainting breakout marks. Higher-timeframe detection projects bigger structure onto any chart, and an optional sentiment profile completes the picture. For traders who want events, not just lines.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Support Resistance Classification
indicators.description: Derives support and resistance levels from higher-timeframe references (moving averages, band extremes, previous highs and lows, Fibonacci pivots, or swings) over a fixed lookback, then grades each from 1 (strongest) to 10. Up to five value sets can be displayed at once for comparison. For traders who want their levels ranked, not just drawn.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Support Resistance Classification (VR)
indicators.description: Scores every support and resistance level found in the visible chart range from 1 to 10, strongest first, built from higher-timeframe references such as moving averages, band extremes, Fibonacci pivots, and swings. Scroll or zoom and the classification recalculates to match the view. Suited to traders who grade levels before trusting them.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: SVE Bands
indicators.description: SVE Bands centers a volatility envelope on double-smoothed typical price (8-bar exponential pass then a second average) and offsets it by an EMA of a range-flavored deviation measure times 3.55, the lower band pulled to 0.9 of the upper offset. Slope-colored centerline, gradient fills and excursion/reversion alerts target calmer mean-reversion reads.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Sweep Volume Index
indicators.description: An oscillator measuring the volume traded specifically during liquidity sweeps, using intrabar data to count only activity beyond a swept swing high or low. Heavy sweep volume exposes stop-runs and possible absorption; light sweeps hint at unopposed continuation. Decaying envelopes frame every spike against recent sweep history.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Sweeps & IFVGs
indicators.description: Marks liquidity sweeps of prior swing highs and lows alongside inverse fair value gaps: failed gaps that flip into opposite support or resistance. Sweep areas can extend across the chart, an ATR-based filter admits only meaningful gaps, and alerts cover both event types. A focused reversal toolkit for price action traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Swing Breakout Sequence
indicators.description: Maps the five-point Swing Breakout Sequence on your chart: two failed breakout attempts from a swing zone, a deeper pullback that runs the liquidity left behind, and the reversal that tees up a third, decisive break. Every stage is plotted and boxed, giving directional scalpers a repeatable way to read pressure building inside swing zones.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Swing Failure Pattern (SFP)
indicators.description: Detects and labels swing failure patterns: wicks that pierce a swing high or low but close back inside, the footprint of engineered stop runs before reversals. A confirmation level validates each turn, and an intrabar volume filter keeps only SFPs where the right share of volume traded beyond the swing. Built for liquidity-minded reversal traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Swing Highs/Lows & Candle Patterns
indicators.description: Labels every confirmed swing point as HH, HL, LH, or LL and names the candle pattern that formed there, covering hammers, inverse hammers, hanging men, shooting stars, and bullish or bearish engulfing bars. One Length input tunes swing sensitivity, making it a fast structural read for price action traders who lean on candle confirmation.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Swing Index
indicators.description: Plots Wilder's per-bar Swing Index (the signed measure of the true two-bar change built from both bars' opens and closes, scaled toward the -100/+100 extremes) with the limit-move factor T set automatically from the highest excursion over 252 bars or fixed manually. Dashed strong-swing levels sit at 50 and -50, and six alerts include validation of new 20-bar highs and lows.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Swing Magnitude Filters
indicators.description: Swing Magnitude Filters confirms a swing only after price reverses a full threshold, 3.0 x ATR(14) by default, or a percentage or point distance, drawing the filtered zigzag over the faint raw candidate structure it replaces. A dashboard reports noise removed, average leg size, confirmation delay and flip progress, and quiet stretches flag possible ranges.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Swing Structure Scanner
indicators.description: A dashboard that streams the swing structure of up to six tickers or timeframes at once, drawing each as a compact graph of swing points positioned against their predecessors. Spot higher lows building across a watchlist, or confluence stacking up across timeframes of one market, without cycling through charts to find it.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Swing Volume Profiles
indicators.description: Builds a volume profile between consecutive swing points, revealing where trading activity concentrated inside each structural leg. Point of Control and value area levels project forward as support and resistance, naked PoCs stay tracked until price returns, and unfilled liquidity voids are flagged, with alerts on PoC, VAH, and VAL interactions.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Swiss Army Knife Filter
indicators.description: Runs John Ehlers' generalized second-order recursion and plugs in one of seven coefficient sets (EMA, Gaussian, Butterworth, two high-pass forms, band-pass or band-stop) from a single 20-bar Period input. Price-domain types draw over price, oscillator types center on zero in the pane, a table exposes the five live coefficients, and a comparison instance can run alongside.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: SWMA
indicators.description: Plots the symmetric weighted moving average: the classic 4-bar 1-2-2-1 kernel by default, generalized to any window with mirrored weights, always delaying what it passes by exactly (length - 1) / 2 bars. Slope coloring and turn alerts, an optional longer average fed by the SWMA in its documented pre-filter role, and a dashboard stating the window and its constant delay.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: T3
indicators.description: T3 plots Tim Tillson's triple generalized-DEMA smoother, six cascaded 14-period EMAs recombined with volume-factor coefficients (0.7 default), as a slope-colored line on price. An optional fast-T3 crossover pair, same-length EMA and v = 0 cascade comparisons, and a dashboard tracking slope, price bias and overshoot round out the build.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Targets For Many Indicators
indicators.description: Prints managed trade targets whenever a condition you define fires between two series, with more than thirty built-in sources spanning RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, Supertrend, and VWAP, plus external indicator inputs. Targets renew or wait according to your rules, distances flex from ticks to ATR multiples, and a dashboard scores reach rates.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Targets For Overlay Indicators
indicators.description: Attaches automatic trade targets to any overlay source on your chart: one target type when price crosses over it, another when price crosses under, each with alerts for newly set and reached levels. Works with moving averages, bands, and trailing stops, while a dashboard reports how often each target type actually gets hit.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Temporal Volume Profile 3D
indicators.description: Renders volume as a rotatable 3D terrain, with price across, time in depth, and traded volume as height, so liquidity can be watched building, migrating, and fading rather than read from one flattened histogram. A POC ridge line traces fair value through time, and a peak proximity warning fires as price re-enters major high-volume zones.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: The Echo Forecast
indicators.description: A forecasting tool that scans history for the window most correlated, or deliberately most dissimilar, to recent price action and projects what followed it forward. Reference, match, and forecast are all drawn on the chart, with cumulative, mean, or linear-regression construction modes. Sharpest on detrended, periodic series such as oscillators.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: The Range Indicator
indicators.description: Plots Jack Weinberg's TRI: each bar's true range over its close-to-close gain on up-closing bars, stochastic-normalized across 10 bars, smoothed by a 3-period EMA and bounded 0 to 100. Dashed thresholds at 80 and 20 separate churn extremes from efficient travel, and four alerts fire as the reading crosses either threshold in either direction.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: The Strat
indicators.description: The complete toolkit for trading The Strat: every candle numbered 1, 2 up, 2 down, or 3, a custom combo search that boxes matching sequences on the chart, pivot machine gun detection, and a statistics dashboard with multi-timeframe numbers. Alerts cover specific candle numbers, custom combos, and PMGs.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Three Bar Reversal Pattern
indicators.description: Automatic detection for three-bar reversal patterns, drawn straight on the price chart with support and resistance levels derived from each pattern's boundaries. Normal, Enhanced, or All detection modes control strictness, and an optional trend filter using a Moving Average Cloud, Supertrend, or Donchian Channels keeps aligned or contrarian signals.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Three Black Crows
indicators.description: Detects the three-crows bearish reversal with its qualifications enforced: three long dark candles closing near their lows at progressively lower levels, each opening inside the prior body, after a confirmed advance. It flags the identical-crows variant, structure breaks and exhaustion, and draws bounce levels at the pattern midpoint and first crow open, with five alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Three Drive Pattern Detector
indicators.description: Detects completed Three Drives patterns with a multi-length swing engine that evaluates up to 99 swing lengths at once, surfacing formations any single setting would miss. Retracement and extension ratios are adjustable around the classic 0.618 and 1.272 anchors, and a dashboard timestamps the most recent detection.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Three Inside Up/down
indicators.description: Detects three inside up and three inside down (the harami plus its confirming candle) under the strict rule by default: a long first body, a contained counter-trend second body, and a third close beyond the first candle's extreme. Trend context is checked at the first candle, dashed invalidation levels track each pattern's far extreme, and four alerts cover completions and failures.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: TICK Arbitrage Toolkit
indicators.description: Streams NYSE TICK or NASDAQ TICKQ market breadth directly onto your price bars, grading internal pressure through three extension levels with intensifying color and session high/low labels. Sub-minute sampling catches spikes that live and die inside a single bar. Built for index scalpers and mean-reversion traders timing exhaustion in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Tirone Levels
indicators.description: Draws both published Tirone constructions from a window's extremes: the three-line midpoint method carving the high-low range into thirds, and the mean ladder around the adjusted mean (H + L + C) / 3, over a 20-bar rolling window or from a fixed anchor time. Gradient zones, bar-by-bar level history and six alerts on center crosses, third entries and range failures.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: TPO Profile
indicators.description: TPO Profile stacks letter-based time-price distributions per anchor period (30-minute letters over daily sessions by default), marking the TPO point of control, a 70% value area and a two-period initial balance. Prior-session POC and value area edges extend forward as reference levels, with alerts on range extensions and level crosses.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Trade Volume Index
indicators.description: Plots the cumulative Trade Volume Index as a line colored by its live accumulation, distribution or neutral classification, with the minimum tick value defaulting to the instrument tick size and an optional intrabar granularity. Flags price extremes TVI fails to confirm, shades quiet accumulation or distribution in flat markets, and carries seven alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Traders Dynamic Index
indicators.description: Traders Dynamic Index derives four lines from one 13-period RSI: a 2-period price line, a 7-period signal line, and Bollinger Bands on the RSI whose 34-period midline is the market base line. Crossover, midline and band-press events feed ten alerts, with classic 68/32 zones and gradient fills completing the all-in-one momentum panel.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Trading-range Position
indicators.description: Boxes confirmed trading ranges and reads where price sits inside them: the lowest subdivision fills as buy territory, the highest as sell territory, the middle as a no-trade zone, on a thirds or quarters grid. Edge bands span tested support and resistance, recovered pokes reset the effective extremes, and a dashboard plus ten alerts track position, tests and resolution.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Trailing Peak Activity Level
indicators.description: Marks the price of the session's highest-volume bar and trails it as a live level, updating only when a new volume peak lands far enough away to clear an ATR-scaled filter. Dotted shift lines flag when peak activity migrates higher or lower, and a dashboard tracks the level and its volume. A lean alternative to a full profile for day traders who want one decisive line.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Trend Intensity Index
indicators.description: Plots M.H. Pee's Trend Intensity Index: the upside share of recent deviations from a 60-bar simple moving average, accumulated over a 30-bar window and scaled 0 to 100 with a gradient fill around the 50 midline. Dashed levels at 80 and 20 grade established trends, a bar-count variant is built in, and six alerts cover level and midline crossings.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Trend Magic
indicators.description: Trend Magic draws a ratcheting trailing line whose side is set by a 20-period CCI's sign (below price while the CCI holds at or above zero, above price once it turns negative) with a 5-period ATR sizing the offset. Flip markers, a gradient trail fill and alerts on flips and line tests make it a momentum-gated trailing-stop reference.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Trend Regularity Adaptive Moving Average
indicators.description: An adaptive moving average whose smoothing keys off trend regularity: the more new highs or lows price prints, the tighter it hugs the move, while ranges flatten it into a stable line. Use it for crossovers that can fire earlier in persistent trends, or as trailing support and resistance. A LuxAlgo original for trend traders tired of one-speed averages.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Trend Volume Accumulations
indicators.description: Accumulates volume into trend-aligned waves in the spirit of Weis wave analysis: rising volume builds positive waves, declining volume carves negative ones, and wave color tracks a rolling linear regression. Adaptive upper and lower levels flag stretched waves where reversals become likelier. For traders who weigh the effort behind a move, not just its direction.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Trend-quality Composites
indicators.description: Trend-quality Composites blends five 0-100 ingredients into one weighted trend-quality score: a percentile-ranked RAVI spread from a 7/65 average pair, plus Kaufman Efficiency Ratio, directional consistency, R-squared fit and ATR-adjusted slope sharing a 14-bar window. Tier thresholds at 60/40 gate trend-following versus range tactics, with a component dashboard and tier alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Trending Market Toolkit
indicators.description: Builds complete entry models on trending structure: it detects reversals and broken trendlines, draws reversal areas as trade triggers, and maps targets and stops with live risk-reward metrics. Detection can run on your chart's timeframe or a higher one, and a threshold filters out trades below your minimum R:R. A framework tool for discretionary traders.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Trendline Breakout Navigator
indicators.description: Maintains three self-optimizing trendlines at once (long, medium, and short term), each born from swing points and refined against historical closes. Dots mark wick tests that pierced a line without a closing break, bar colors grade every close against all three slopes, and background flips flag breaks of your chosen line. For trend traders who want diagonal structure at three scales.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Trendline Liquidity
indicators.description: Finds rising support and falling resistance lines with three or more respected touches, then draws the diagonal band of inferred resting orders beyond each line, deepening with every touch. Pierces resolve as liquidity sweeps or genuine breaks through reclaim, displacement and acceptance rules, with structure shifts confirming sweeps and ten alerts end to end.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Trendlines Oscillator
indicators.description: Turns trendline structure into momentum: it measures how far price sits from recent bullish support and bearish resistance trendlines, normalizes both distances to a 0-100 scale, and plots dueling momentum lines with a signal line and crossing dots. A structure-driven alternative to averaging oscillators for reading whether buyers or sellers hold control.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Trendlines with Breaks
indicators.description: Draws pivot-anchored support and resistance trendlines whose slope you control (ATR-scaled by default, standard deviation or linear regression optional) and flags breakouts in real time with integrated alerts. Repainting can be disabled to lock lines in place. A clean baseline for breakout traders who trade diagonal structure without drawing it by hand.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Trendlines with Breaks Oscillator
indicators.description: Converts trendline breakouts into momentum: synthetic EMAs smooth the distances price travels beyond bullish and bearish breaks, and their delta oscillates around zero with breakout dots, a signal line, and a built-in divergence detector. For traders who want breakout pressure quantified on a single pane instead of eyeballed across a chart.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Tri-star
indicators.description: Detects strict tri-stars (three consecutive doji whose middle doji gaps beyond its neighbors after a trend qualified by a 50-bar SMA), plus an optional loose variant without the gap. Doji bodies must stay under 5% of the bar range and 0.25x the average body, and each pattern is tracked to a confirming close, timeout or invalidation, with eight alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Triangle
indicators.description: Detects completed Elliott triangles from the last six swing points, classifying contracting, barrier, expanding and running variants and checking that every leg subdivides into threes. Draws the A-C and B-D boundaries with apex extensions, previews forming structures, and manages the thrust with a widest-part target and invalidation depth, plus eleven alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Triangular Momentum Oscillator & Real Time Divergences
indicators.description: A smooth oscillator built on the momentum of a triangular moving average, letting divergences register in real time: tops and bottoms are confirmed the moment the first difference crosses zero, with no pivot wait. Optional correlation coloring exposes where the oscillator leads or lags price. For divergence traders who are tired of late signals.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: TRIX
indicators.description: TRIX plots the one-bar percentage rate of change of a triple-smoothed exponential moving average of price, producing a momentum oscillator that fluctuates around a zero line. The default smoothing length is 18. This is the standard raw implementation of Hutson's TRIX with the classic setting.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: True Strength Index
indicators.description: The True Strength Index double-smooths one-bar price change and its absolute value with successive EMAs, then plots their ratio as a momentum oscillator centered on zero. It uses the classic defaults of 25 and 13 for the two smoothing lengths with a 13-period signal line. The build reproduces the standard published calculation without modification.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Truncation
indicators.description: Detects truncated fifth waves (a five-wave impulse whose final wave stops short of the wave 3 extreme), validated against the Elliott hard rules and, by default, a five-wave subdivision inside wave 5. Shades the shortfall zone, draws confirmation at the wave 4 extreme and invalidation at wave 3, and reports divergence and volume evidence, with six alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: TTM Squeeze
indicators.description: TTM Squeeze marks volatility compression with zero-line dots that switch on while the Bollinger Bands sit fully inside the Keltner Channels, paired with a regression-based momentum histogram for the directional lean. Defaults follow John Carter's construction: length 20, multipliers 2 and 1.5. Built for breakout traders who want the coil and its release read from one pane.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Turn-of-month Effects
indicators.description: Highlights the turn-of-month window (the last trading day of the old month through the first three sessions of the new one by default), tinting each day by its own historical average return on the charted symbol. A dashboard breaks down per-day averages, win rates, window-versus-other-day returns and cumulative comparisons, with window start and end alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Tweezer Top/bottom
indicators.description: Detects tweezer tops and bottoms (consecutive candles matching highs or lows within a tick- and ATR-scaled tolerance after a qualifying 1-ATR move) and grades each with a confluence score for rejection wicks and prior support or resistance. Matched levels extend until a close invalidates them, with boxes, starred labels and four alerts.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Twiggs Money Flow
indicators.description: Twiggs Money Flow plots a volume-weighted pressure line bounded between -1 and +1, signing each bar's volume by where the close lands in its true range and smoothing with Wilder-style averaging over 21 bars. Dashed thresholds at plus and minus 0.05 mark sustained accumulation and distribution. For traders who want a money-flow read that gaps cannot slip past.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: UHL Adaptive MA
indicators.description: UHL Adaptive MA plots Andreas Uhl's corrected moving average: a 100-bar variance gate holds the line perfectly flat inside noise and steps it toward the simple average when movement is statistically meaningful. A fast trend-step line, crossover states, and a dashboard with the live correction factor complete the build. For trend followers tired of averages that drift sideways.
indicators.author: LuxAlgo

indicators.name: Ulcer Index
